test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Impute (median from fold TRAIN only) + Scale (fit on fold TRAIN only)
#    -> no leakage; done separately PER FOLD so each fold's scaler/median is
#    fit exclusively on that fold's training portion.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fold_data = []
for fold_i, (train_pos, val_pos) in enumerate(fold_indices):
    X_train_fold_raw = X_all_raw.iloc[train_pos].reset_index(drop=True)
    X_val_fold_raw = X_all_raw.iloc[val_pos].reset_index(drop=True)

    fold_median = X_train_fold_raw.median()
    X_train_fold_raw = X_train_fold_raw.fillna(fold_median)
    X_val_fold_raw = X_val_fold_raw.fillna(fold_median)
    X_test_fold_raw = X_test_raw.fillna(fold_median)

    fold_scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_fold = fold_scaler.fit_transform(X_train_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)
    X_val_fold = fold_scaler.transform(X_val_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)
    X_test_fold = fold_scaler.transform(X_test_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)

    fold_data.append(
        {
            "X_train": X_train_fold,
            "X_val": X_val_fold,
            "X_test": X_test_fold,
            "y_train": y_all[train_pos],
            "y_val": y_all[val_pos],
            "train_pos": train_pos,
            "val_pos": val_pos,
            "scaler": fold_scaler,
            "median": fold_median,
        }
    )
    print(
        f"Fold {fold_i}: train={len(train_pos)}, val={len(val_pos)} "
        f"(stratified by species, classes represented in train={len(np.unique(y_all[train_pos]))}/{num_classes}, "
        f"val={len(np.unique(y_all[val_pos]))}/{num_classes})"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Persist processed artifacts for downstream modeling steps
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
joblib.dump(
    {
        "fold_data": fold_data,
        "fold_indices": fold_indices,
        "num_folds": NUM_FOLDS,
        "test_ids": test_ids,
    },
    os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "processed_data.joblib"),
)

joblib.dump(
    {
        "label_encoder": label_encoder,
        "species_classes": species_classes,
        "feature_cols": X_cols,
        "num_classes": num_classes,
        "fold_indices": fold_indices,
        "num_folds": NUM_FOLDS,
    },
    os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "preprocessing_artifacts.joblib"),
)

print(
    f"Saved processed_data.joblib -> {NUM_FOLDS} folds, each with "
    f"X_train{fold_data[0]['X_train'].shape}, X_val{fold_data[0]['X_val'].shape}, "
    f"X_test{fold_data[0]['X_test'].shape}"
)
print("Data processing and feature engineering complete.")

# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design
# ==================================================================

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load artifacts from the data_processing step to size the model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
artifacts = joblib.load(os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "preprocessing_artifacts.joblib"))
processed = joblib.load(os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "processed_data.joblib"))

all_cols = artifacts[
    "feature_cols"
]  # exact column order used to build X_train/X_val/X_test
num_classes = artifacts["num_classes"]
total_input_dim = processed["fold_data"][0]["X_train"].shape[1]
assert total_input_dim == len(all_cols), "feature_cols / X_train column count mismatch"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Recover the modality block boundaries (margin / shape / texture /
#    engineered block-stats / image-geometry) from the column names so the
#    network can route each modality through its own encoder before fusion.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def _is_raw_block(col, prefix):
    return col.startswith(prefix) and col[len(prefix) :].isdigit()


margin_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(all_cols) if _is_raw_block(c, "margin")]
shape_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(all_cols) if _is_raw_block(c, "shape")]
texture_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(all_cols) if _is_raw_block(c, "texture")]
stats_suffixes = ("_mean", "_std", "_max", "_argmax", "_entropy")
stats_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(all_cols) if c.endswith(stats_suffixes)]
image_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(all_cols) if c.startswith("img_")]

routed = (
    set(margin_idx)
    | set(shape_idx)
    | set(texture_idx)
    | set(stats_idx)
    | set(image_idx)
)
assert routed == set(
    range(total_input_dim)
), "some feature columns were not routed to any branch"
assert len(routed) == total_input_dim, "overlapping column routing detected"

print(
    f"Modality block sizes -> margin={len(margin_idx)}, shape={len(shape_idx)}, "
    f"texture={len(texture_idx)}, engineered_stats={len(stats_idx)}, image_geom={len(image_idx)}, "
    f"total={total_input_dim}, num_classes={num_classes}"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Multi-branch architecture: one small encoder per feature modality,
#    fused by concatenation into a final classification head.
#    LayerNorm (not BatchNorm) is used since it is stable regardless of the
#    batch size chosen by the training step, and Dropout is used throughout
#    to counter overfitting on the very small (~7-9 samples/class) dataset.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class ModalityBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, hidden_dim, out_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, out_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(out_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiBranchLeafNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        margin_idx,
        shape_idx,
        texture_idx,
        stats_idx,
        image_idx,
        num_classes,
        branch_dropout=0.4,
        head_dropout=0.5,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.register_buffer("margin_idx", torch.tensor(margin_idx, dtype=torch.long))
        self.register_buffer("shape_idx", torch.tensor(shape_idx, dtype=torch.long))
        self.register_buffer("texture_idx", torch.tensor(texture_idx, dtype=torch.long))
        self.register_buffer("stats_idx", torch.tensor(stats_idx, dtype=torch.long))
        self.register_buffer("image_idx", torch.tensor(image_idx, dtype=torch.long))

        self.margin_branch = ModalityBranch(len(margin_idx), 128, 64, branch_dropout)
        self.shape_branch = ModalityBranch(len(shape_idx), 128, 64, branch_dropout)
        self.texture_branch = ModalityBranch(len(texture_idx), 128, 64, branch_dropout)
        self.stats_branch = ModalityBranch(
            max(len(stats_idx), 1), 32, 32, branch_dropout * 0.75
        )
        self.image_branch = ModalityBranch(
            max(len(image_idx), 1), 16, 16, branch_dropout * 0.5
        )

        fused_dim = 64 + 64 + 64 + 32 + 16
        self.fusion_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(fused_dim, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(head_dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(head_dropout * 0.6),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x_margin = self.margin_branch(torch.index_select(x, 1, self.margin_idx))
        x_shape = self.shape_branch(torch.index_select(x, 1, self.shape_idx))
        x_texture = self.texture_branch(torch.index_select(x, 1, self.texture_idx))
        x_stats = self.stats_branch(torch.index_select(x, 1, self.stats_idx))
        x_image = self.image_branch(torch.index_select(x, 1, self.image_idx))
        fused = torch.cat([x_margin, x_shape, x_texture, x_stats, x_image], dim=1)
        logits = self.fusion_head(
            fused
        )  # raw logits; softmax applied by CrossEntropyLoss / at inference
        return logits


model = MultiBranchLeafNet(
    margin_idx=margin_idx,
    shape_idx=shape_idx,
    texture_idx=texture_idx,
    stats_idx=stats_idx,
    image_idx=image_idx,
    num_classes=num_classes,
    branch_dropout=0.4,
    head_dropout=0.5,
).to(device)

num_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
print(
    f"MultiBranchLeafNet instantiated on {device} with {num_params:,} trainable parameters"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Loss: CrossEntropyLoss over logits directly targets multi-class
#    log-loss (the official metric). Label smoothing counters overconfident
#    softmax outputs, which is critical here since a single wrong species
#    guessed at near-1.0 probability incurs a large log-loss penalty on a
#    dataset with only a handful of samples per class.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Optimizer + LR schedule: AdamW with weight decay for regularization,
#    cosine annealing to smoothly decay the LR (helps convergence/calibration
#    late in training on this small dataset). T_max is a placeholder the
#    training step may align to its chosen epoch budget.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
    optimizer, T_max=150, eta_min=1e-5
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Complementary linear companion model: with only a handful of samples
#    per class and 213 features, a well-regularized multinomial logistic
#    regression is a low-variance, complementary probability estimate to
#    the NN branch-fusion model. One instance is fit per fold inside the
#    training_evaluation step (since it needs per-fold data); the
#    hyperparameters and blending helper are defined here for reuse.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
LOGREG_PARAMS = dict(
    penalty="l2",
    C=0.5,
    solver="lbfgs",
    max_iter=2000,
    multi_class="multinomial",
)
# Shrinkage LDA: explicitly models between/within-class scatter, a documented
# strong classical method on this exact leaf-species dataset given ~7-9
# samples/class and 213 features.
LDA_PARAMS = dict(
    solver="lsqr",
    shrinkage="auto",
)
# Margin-maximizing linear SVM (calibrated for predict_proba): a
# decision-boundary perspective the NN/LogReg/LDA (probability/likelihood
# based) do not capture, adding ensemble diversity.
SVM_PARAMS = dict(
    C=0.5,
    max_iter=5000,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
)
ALPHA = 0.6  # LEGACY fixed blend weight for NN/LogReg; superseded by the OOF-trained stacking meta-model in training_evaluation


def blend_probs(nn_probs, lr_probs, alpha=ALPHA):
    # LEGACY fixed blend, retained only for backward compatibility / reference; not used by the stacking pipeline
    return alpha * nn_probs + (1 - alpha) * lr_probs


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Persist the architecture configuration so the training/inference steps
#    can reconstruct an identical model if run in a separate process.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model_config = {
    "margin_idx": margin_idx,
    "shape_idx": shape_idx,
    "texture_idx": texture_idx,
    "stats_idx": stats_idx,
    "image_idx": image_idx,
    "num_classes": num_classes,
    "branch_dropout": 0.4,
    "head_dropout": 0.5,
    "alpha_blend": ALPHA,
}
joblib.dump(model_config, os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "model_config.joblib"))
print(
    "Model design complete: MultiBranchLeafNet, CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1), "
    "AdamW+CosineAnnealingLR, and LogisticRegression/LDA/SVM companion learners "
    "(legacy alpha_blend=0.6, superseded by OOF stacking meta-model) saved."
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

BEST_MODEL_PATH_TEMPLATE = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_model_fold{fold}.pt")

MAX_EPOCHS = 150
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE = 25
ALL_CLASS_LABELS = list(range(num_classes))  # fixed label order for log_loss

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Loop over the 5 CV folds: fresh NN + fresh LogisticRegression per fold,
#    early stopping on that fold's validation log-loss exactly as before,
#    then blend both models' probabilities on that fold's val split.
#    Collect the blended out-of-fold probabilities for ALL 891 training
#    samples into a single OOF array aligned to y_all.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_probs_by_model = np.zeros((len(y_all), 4, num_classes), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_by_model_folds = []

for fold_i, fold in enumerate(fold_data):
    X_train_fold = fold["X_train"]
    X_val_fold = fold["X_val"]
    X_test_fold = fold["X_test"]
    y_train_fold = fold["y_train"]
    y_val_fold = fold["y_val"]
    val_pos = fold["val_pos"]

    fold_model = MultiBranchLeafNet(
        margin_idx=margin_idx,
        shape_idx=shape_idx,
        texture_idx=texture_idx,
        stats_idx=stats_idx,
        image_idx=image_idx,
        num_classes=num_classes,
        branch_dropout=0.4,
        head_dropout=0.5,
    ).to(device)
    fold_criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
    fold_optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        fold_model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4
    )
    fold_scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        fold_optimizer, T_max=150, eta_min=1e-5
    )

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(X_train_fold).float(), torch.from_numpy(y_train_fold).long()
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda"),
        drop_last=False,
    )

    X_val_tensor = torch.from_numpy(X_val_fold).float().to(device)

    fold_best_model_path = BEST_MODEL_PATH_TEMPLATE.format(fold=fold_i)
    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_without_improvement = 0

    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        fold_model.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            fold_optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = fold_model(xb)
            loss = fold_criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            fold_optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)

        fold_scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        # ---- validation pass ----
        fold_model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_logits = fold_model(X_val_tensor)
            val_probs = torch.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_fold, val_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_LABELS)

        improved = val_logloss < best_val_logloss - 1e-5
        if improved:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_without_improvement = 0
            torch.save(fold_model.state_dict(), fold_best_model_path)
        else:
            epochs_without_improvement += 1

        print(
            f"Fold {fold_i} Epoch {epoch}/{MAX_EPOCHS} - train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
            f"val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f}"
            + (" *" if improved else "")
        )

        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"Fold {fold_i}: early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch} "
                f"(no improvement for {EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE} epochs)."
            )
            break

    # ---- load best checkpoint for this fold ----
    fold_model.load_state_dict(torch.load(fold_best_model_path, map_location=device))
    fold_model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        val_logits_final = fold_model(X_val_tensor)
        nn_val_probs = torch.softmax(val_logits_final, dim=1).cpu().numpy()

    # ---- fit this fold's complementary companion models: LogReg, shrinkage
    #      LDA, and a calibrated linear SVM ----
    fold_logreg = LogisticRegression(**LOGREG_PARAMS)
    fold_logreg.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    lr_val_probs = fold_logreg.predict_proba(X_val_fold)
    assert list(fold_logreg.classes_) == ALL_CLASS_LABELS, "LogReg class order mismatch"

    fold_lda = LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(**LDA_PARAMS)
    fold_lda.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    lda_val_probs = fold_lda.predict_proba(X_val_fold)
    assert list(fold_lda.classes_) == ALL_CLASS_LABELS, "LDA class order mismatch"

    fold_svm = CalibratedClassifierCV(LinearSVC(**SVM_PARAMS), cv=3)
    fold_svm.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    svm_val_probs = fold_svm.predict_proba(X_val_fold)
    assert list(fold_svm.classes_) == ALL_CLASS_LABELS, "SVM class order mismatch"

    # ---- stack all 4 base learners' val-set probabilities into the OOF
    #      matrix (aligned to val_pos) for the post-loop stacking meta-model ----
    fold_oof_stack = np.stack(
        [nn_val_probs, lr_val_probs, lda_val_probs, svm_val_probs], axis=1
    )
    oof_probs_by_model[val_pos] = fold_oof_stack

    print(
        f"Fold {fold_i} complete: best_nn_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} "
        f"lr_val_logloss={log_loss(y_val_fold, lr_val_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_LABELS):.4f} "
        f"lda_val_logloss={log_loss(y_val_fold, lda_val_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_LABELS):.4f} "
        f"svm_val_logloss={log_loss(y_val_fold, svm_val_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_LABELS):.4f}"
    )

    # ---- test inference for this fold: collect all 4 base learners' probs
    #      (NN softmax, LogReg/LDA/SVM predict_proba), using the IDENTICAL
    #      processing path used for OOF validation above, for the post-loop
    #      stacking meta-model to combine ----
    X_test_tensor = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        test_logits = fold_model(X_test_tensor)
        nn_test_probs = torch.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    lr_test_probs = fold_logreg.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    lda_test_probs = fold_lda.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    svm_test_probs = fold_svm.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    fold_test_stack = np.stack(
        [nn_test_probs, lr_test_probs, lda_test_probs, svm_test_probs], axis=1
    )
    test_probs_by_model_folds.append(fold_test_stack)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit a multinomial LogisticRegression meta-model on the full-training-set
#    OOF stacking matrix (4 base learners' class-probabilities stacked as
#    99*4=396 meta-features). Every OOF row was produced by base learners
#    that never saw that sample's label during their own fold, so this stage
#    is leakage-free. The Final Validation Score is the official multi-class
#    log-loss of the meta-model's OWN predict_proba on the OOF stacking
#    matrix, over all 891 training samples via true out-of-fold predictions.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
META_PARAMS = dict(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, multi_class="multinomial")
oof_meta_features = oof_probs_by_model.reshape(len(y_all), -1)

# Genuine nested OOF: fit the meta-model only on each fold's TRAIN rows and
# predict its VAL rows, so the reported score never evaluates the meta-model
# on rows it was fit on (avoids leakage at the stacking layer).
oof_probs = np.zeros((len(y_all), num_classes), dtype=np.float64)
for train_pos, val_pos in fold_indices:
    fold_meta_model = LogisticRegression(**META_PARAMS)
    fold_meta_model.fit(oof_meta_features[train_pos], y_all[train_pos])
    assert list(fold_meta_model.classes_) == ALL_CLASS_LABELS, "meta-model class order mismatch"
    oof_probs[val_pos] = fold_meta_model.predict_proba(oof_meta_features[val_pos])
score = log_loss(y_all, oof_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_LABELS)

# Final meta-model refit on all OOF rows, used only for test-set inference below.
meta_model = LogisticRegression(**META_PARAMS)
meta_model.fit(oof_meta_features, y_all)
assert list(meta_model.classes_) == ALL_CLASS_LABELS, "meta-model class order mismatch"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Average each base learner's probabilities across all 5 folds (bagging),
#    then apply the SAME OOF-fitted meta-model to combine the 4
#    fold-averaged base-learner probabilities into the final test_probs.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs_by_model = np.mean(test_probs_by_model_folds, axis=0)
test_meta_features = test_probs_by_model.reshape(len(test_ids), -1)
test_probs = meta_model.predict_proba(test_meta_features)

# class column order must exactly match label_encoder's fitted order
# (label_encoder was fit on species_classes, i.e. sample_submission's column order)
class_columns = list(label_encoder.classes_)
assert (
    class_columns == species_classes
), "label encoder class order must match sample_submission columns"

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=class_columns)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)

submission_path = os.path.join("./submission", "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved submission with shape {submission_df.shape} to {submission_path}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import cv2
from scipy.stats import skew, kurtosis
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegressionCV
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
import joblib

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
WORKING_DIR = "./working"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
IMAGES_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "images")
os.makedirs(WORKING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

RANDOM_STATE = 42

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load raw data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Official label order comes from sample_submission.csv columns (authoritative for submission format)
LABEL_COLUMNS = sample_sub_df.columns[1:].tolist()
assert len(LABEL_COLUMNS) == 99
species_to_idx = {species: idx for idx, species in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS)}

FEATURE_PREFIXES = ["margin", "shape", "texture"]
RAW_FEATURE_COLS = [f"{p}{i}" for p in FEATURE_PREFIXES for i in range(1, 65)]
assert all(c in train_df.columns for c in RAW_FEATURE_COLS)
assert all(c in test_df.columns for c in RAW_FEATURE_COLS)

train_ids = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
y_full = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values
assert not np.any(
    pd.isnull(y_full)
), "Unmapped species found — label encoding misaligned with sample_submission."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified split FIRST (before any fitting of scalers/statistics)
#    Each of the 99 species has 9 train samples; an ~80/20 stratified split
#    keeps every class represented in both folds while giving a real hold-out.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train_df)),
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=y_full,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
)
y_train = y_full[train_idx]
y_val = y_full[val_idx]
train_ids_split = train_ids[train_idx]
val_ids_split = train_ids[val_idx]

raw_train = train_df.iloc[train_idx][RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)
raw_val = train_df.iloc[val_idx][RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)
raw_test = test_df[RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Feature engineering — block-level statistical summaries of the
#    pre-extracted margin/shape/texture histograms (mean/std/min/max/skew/
#    kurtosis per 64-dim block). These compress each 64-d distribution into
#    shape-of-distribution descriptors that complement the raw bins.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def block_stats(raw_matrix):
    n = raw_matrix.shape[0]
    stats = np.zeros((n, len(FEATURE_PREFIXES) * 6), dtype=np.float64)
    for b, prefix in enumerate(FEATURE_PREFIXES):
        block = raw_matrix[:, b * 64 : (b + 1) * 64]
        stats[:, b * 6 + 0] = block.mean(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 1] = block.std(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 2] = block.min(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 3] = block.max(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 4] = skew(block, axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 5] = kurtosis(block, axis=1)
    return np.nan_to_num(stats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


stats_train = block_stats(raw_train)
stats_val = block_stats(raw_val)
stats_test = block_stats(raw_test)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Feature engineering — contour-based geometric descriptors extracted
#    directly from the binary leaf silhouette images (rotation/scale
#    invariant): normalized area/perimeter, aspect ratio, extent, solidity,
#    compactness, eccentricity, and 7 log-scaled Hu moments (15 features).
#    This targets whole-silhouette shape cues distinct from the pre-computed
#    contour-signature histograms already present in the tabular data.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_GEOM_FEATURES = 15


def extract_geometric_features(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    img_area = float(img.shape[0] * img.shape[1])
    img_scale = np.sqrt(img_area) if img_area > 0 else 1.0

    # Leaves are dark silhouettes on a white background -> invert so leaf = foreground
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(contour)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(contour)

    aspect_ratio = (w / h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    extent = (area / (w * h)) if (w * h) > 0 else 0.0

    hull = cv2.convexHull(contour)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = (area / hull_area) if hull_area > 0 else 0.0

    area_norm = area / img_area if img_area > 0 else 0.0
    perimeter_norm = perimeter / img_scale if img_scale > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter_norm = (np.sqrt(4.0 * area / np.pi) / img_scale) if area > 0 else 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2 / area) if area > 0 else 0.0

    if len(contour) >= 5:
        (_, _), (major_axis, minor_axis), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(contour)
        major_axis, minor_axis = max(major_axis, minor_axis), min(
            major_axis, minor_axis
        )
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1.0 - (minor_axis / major_axis) ** 2) if major_axis > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0

    moments = cv2.moments(contour)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu_log = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)

    feats = np.array(
        [
            area_norm,
            perimeter_norm,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter_norm,
            compactness,
            eccentricity,
        ]
        + hu_log.tolist(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    return np.nan_to_num(feats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


geom_train = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_split])
geom_val = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in val_ids_split])
geom_test = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in test_ids])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Assemble full feature matrices and fit scaling ONLY on the training fold
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
X_train_raw = np.concatenate([raw_train, stats_train, geom_train], axis=1)
X_val_raw = np.concatenate([raw_val, stats_val, geom_val], axis=1)
X_test_raw = np.concatenate([raw_test, stats_test, geom_test], axis=1)

FEATURE_NAMES = (
    RAW_FEATURE_COLS
    + [
        f"{p}_{s}"
        for p in FEATURE_PREFIXES
        for s in ["mean", "std", "min", "max", "skew", "kurt"]
    ]
    + [
        "area_norm",
        "perimeter_norm",
        "aspect_ratio",
        "extent",
        "solidity",
        "equiv_diameter_norm",
        "compactness",
        "eccentricity",
    ]
    + [f"hu_log_{i}" for i in range(7)]
)
assert X_train_raw.shape[1] == len(FEATURE_NAMES)

feature_scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train = feature_scaler.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val = feature_scaler.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test = feature_scaler.transform(X_test_raw)

print(
    f"Train features: {X_train.shape}, Val features: {X_val.shape}, Test features: {X_test.shape}"
)
print(
    f"Feature groups -> raw:{len(RAW_FEATURE_COLS)}, block_stats:{stats_train.shape[1]}, geometric:{geom_train.shape[1]}"
)
print(
    f"Classes represented in train split: {len(np.unique(y_train))}/99, in val split: {len(np.unique(y_val))}/99"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Persist processed artifacts for downstream steps
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
joblib.dump(
    {
        "X_train": X_train,
        "y_train": y_train,
        "X_val": X_val,
        "y_val": y_val,
        "X_test": X_test,
        "test_ids": test_ids,
        "LABEL_COLUMNS": LABEL_COLUMNS,
        "FEATURE_NAMES": FEATURE_NAMES,
        "feature_scaler": feature_scaler,
    },
    os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "processed_data.pkl"),
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model architecture: soft-voting ensemble of multinomial LogisticRegressionCV
# and shrinkage-regularized LinearDiscriminantAnalysis. Chosen instead of
# gradient-boosted trees because with only ~7-9 samples/class against 225
# correlated, standardized features, this dataset (Kaggle Leaf Classification)
# is close to linearly/quadratically separable, so a regularized linear
# boundary + covariance-shrinkage LDA estimate class structure far more
# sample-efficiently than tree splits on individual feature thresholds.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)  # 99 species


def align_proba(raw_proba, classes_seen, n_classes):
    """Re-index predict_proba's columns (ordered by classes_seen) onto the
    full 0..n_classes-1 species space, zero-filling any species that were
    absent from the training fold so val/test always share one fixed
    column layout matching LABEL_COLUMNS order."""
    aligned = np.zeros((raw_proba.shape[0], n_classes), dtype=np.float64)
    for col_idx, cls in enumerate(classes_seen):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = raw_proba[:, col_idx]
    row_sums = aligned.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    return aligned / row_sums


class LinearEnsembleClassifier:
    """Equal-weight soft-voting ensemble of LogisticRegressionCV + LDA,
    exposing .fit()/.predict_proba()/.classes_ so downstream code (written
    against a single sklearn-style estimator) needs no further changes."""

    def __init__(self, logreg, lda):
        self.logreg = logreg
        self.lda = lda
        self.classes_ = None

    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.logreg.fit(X, y)
        self.lda.fit(X, y)
        self.classes_ = self.logreg.classes_
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        proba_logreg = align_proba(self.logreg.predict_proba(X), self.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_lda = align_proba(self.lda.predict_proba(X), self.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        combined = 0.5 * proba_logreg + 0.5 * proba_lda
        row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
        return combined / row_sums


model = LinearEnsembleClassifier(
    LogisticRegressionCV(
        Cs=np.logspace(-4, 2, 20),
        cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3),
        multi_class="multinomial",
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=5000,
        penalty="l2",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    ),
    LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto"),
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss function: multinomial (softmax) cross-entropy / log-loss over the 99
# species — this is LightGBM's built-in "multi_logloss" objective used
# internally during boosting, and is algebraically identical to the official
# competition metric. We expose the same formula explicitly via sklearn's
# log_loss for auditable validation scoring in the training step:
#   log_loss(y_true, model.predict_proba(X), labels=range(N_CLASSES))
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
criterion = log_loss

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# "Optimizer": no separate optimizer object here either — LogisticRegressionCV's
# lbfgs solver picks its per-class regularization strength C via 3-fold CV
# over the Cs grid, while LDA has no iterative optimizer at all (closed-form
# class means / pooled covariance with analytic shrinkage). The
# regularization search + shrinkage estimate ARE this ensemble's analogue of
# an optimizer schedule.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
optimizer_config = {
    "logreg_Cs_grid": "logspace(-4, 2, 20)",
    "logreg_cv_folds": 3,
    "lda_shrinkage": "auto",
    "eval_metric": "multi_logloss",
}

print(
    f"Model: LogisticRegressionCV + LDA soft-voting ensemble | classes={N_CLASSES} | features={len(FEATURE_NAMES)}"
)
print(
    f"Loss: multinomial log-loss (multi_logloss) | Optimizer: {optimizer_config}"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training: fit both linear sub-models directly (no boosting iterations to
# stage-log here). Report each sub-model's chosen regularization and its own
# held-out log-loss so the ensemble's validation path stays auditable.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

logreg_val_proba = align_proba(model.logreg.predict_proba(X_val), model.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES)
lda_val_proba = align_proba(model.lda.predict_proba(X_val), model.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
logreg_val_loss = log_loss(y_val, logreg_val_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
lda_val_loss = log_loss(y_val, lda_val_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
print(
    f"LogisticRegressionCV: mean best C_ across classes={np.mean(model.logreg.C_):.5g}, val_log_loss={logreg_val_loss:.5f}"
)
print(
    f"LinearDiscriminantAnalysis (shrinkage={model.lda.shrinkage}): val_log_loss={lda_val_loss:.5f}"
)
print("Training complete: both linear sub-models fitted, no staged boosting iterations to report")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the best model (state at best_iteration_, captured automatically by
# LightGBM's early-stopping bookkeeping) and reload it for inference, so
# validation scoring and test-set prediction both run through the exact
# persisted artifact rather than the in-memory object mutated during fit().
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEST_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_lgbm_model.pkl")
joblib.dump(model, BEST_MODEL_PATH)
best_model = joblib.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation: combine both sub-models' aligned probabilities (equal-weight
# soft vote), using only the already-fitted scaler/model — no leakage from
# val/test into training. align_proba/N_CLASSES are defined above with model.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
val_probs = 0.5 * align_proba(best_model.logreg.predict_proba(X_val), best_model.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES) + \
    0.5 * align_proba(best_model.lda.predict_proba(X_val), best_model.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Official competition metric: multi-class log-loss over ALL 99 species,
# with labels fixed to the full 0..98 range so the formula matches the
# evaluation section exactly even if a species was missing from a fold.
score = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference: same two sub-models, same align_proba post-processing and
# equal-weight combination as validation.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = 0.5 * align_proba(best_model.logreg.predict_proba(X_test), best_model.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES) + \
    0.5 * align_proba(best_model.lda.predict_proba(X_test), best_model.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_df = submission_df[["id"] + LABEL_COLUMNS]

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved submission with shape {submission_df.shape} to {submission_path}")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import cv2
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, TensorDataset
import torchvision.models as tv_models
import joblib
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
IMAGES_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "images")
WORKING_DIR = "./working"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(WORKING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

# ==================================================================
# STEP 1: Data processing & feature engineering
# ==================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load raw data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

LABEL_COLUMNS = sample_sub.columns[
    1:
].tolist()  # authoritative species order for submission
species_to_idx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS)}
idx_to_species = {i: s for s, i in species_to_idx.items()}

TABULAR_COLS = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ("id", "species")]
assert TABULAR_COLS == [c for c in test_df.columns if c != "id"]

y_all = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values.astype(np.int64)
train_ids_all = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

print(
    f"Train rows: {len(train_df)}, Test rows: {len(test_df)}, Classes: {len(LABEL_COLUMNS)}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified split FIRST (avoid leakage into any fitted stats)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class_counts = pd.Series(y_all).value_counts()
min_class_count = class_counts.min()
try:
    if min_class_count < 2:
        raise ValueError("some class has <2 samples, cannot stratify")
    train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
        np.arange(len(train_df)), test_size=0.15, stratify=y_all, random_state=SEED
    )
except ValueError:
    train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
        np.arange(len(train_df)), test_size=0.15, random_state=SEED
    )

y_train = y_all[train_idx]
y_val = y_all[val_idx]
print(
    f"Split -> train: {len(train_idx)}, val: {len(val_idx)} (min class count in full train: {min_class_count})"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Tabular features: raw 192-dim descriptors + per-family summary stats
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def add_family_stats(df):
    feats = {}
    for family in ("margin", "shape", "texture"):
        cols = [c for c in TABULAR_COLS if c.startswith(family)]
        vals = df[cols].values
        feats[f"{family}_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_argmax"] = vals.argmax(axis=1).astype(float)
    return pd.DataFrame(feats, index=df.index)


train_stats = add_family_stats(train_df)
test_stats = add_family_stats(test_df)

tabular_train_full = np.concatenate(
    [train_df[TABULAR_COLS].values, train_stats.values], axis=1
)
tabular_test_full = np.concatenate(
    [test_df[TABULAR_COLS].values, test_stats.values], axis=1
)

tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[train_idx])
tabular_train_scaled_all = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full)
tabular_test_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Hand-crafted geometric / Hu-moment shape features from raw images
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
GEO_DIM = 16


def extract_geometric_features(img_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    c = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(c)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(c)
    aspect_ratio = w / float(h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    rect_area = w * h
    extent = area / rect_area if rect_area > 0 else 0.0
    hull = cv2.convexHull(c)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = area / hull_area if hull_area > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter = np.sqrt(4 * area / np.pi) if area > 0 else 0.0
    if len(c) >= 5:
        _, (MA, ma), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(c)
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1 - (min(MA, ma) / max(MA, ma)) ** 2) if max(MA, ma) > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2) / area if area > 0 else 0.0
    circularity = 4 * np.pi * area / (perimeter**2) if perimeter > 0 else 0.0
    moments = cv2.moments(c)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)
    geo = np.array(
        [
            area,
            perimeter,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter,
            eccentricity,
            compactness,
            circularity,
        ],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    return np.concatenate([geo, hu.astype(np.float32)])


geo_train_full = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_all])
geo_test = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in test_ids])
geo_train_full = np.nan_to_num(geo_train_full, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
geo_test = np.nan_to_num(geo_test, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[train_idx])
geo_train_scaled_all = geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full)
geo_test_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Frozen pretrained-CNN embeddings (flip-averaged) + train-only PCA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
IMG_SIZE = 128
IMAGENET_MEAN = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
IMAGENET_STD = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(1, 3, 1, 1)


class LeafImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids):
        self.ids = ids

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if img is None:
            img = np.zeros((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.resize(img, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        tensor = torch.from_numpy(img).float().unsqueeze(0) / 255.0
        tensor = tensor.repeat(3, 1, 1)
        return tensor


try:
    from torchvision.models import ResNet18_Weights

    backbone = tv_models.resnet18(weights=ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
except Exception:
    try:
        backbone = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=True)
    except Exception:
        backbone = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=False)

feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(*list(backbone.children())[:-1]).to(DEVICE).eval()
for p in feature_extractor.parameters():
    p.requires_grad_(False)


def extract_cnn_embeddings(ids):
    dataset = LeafImageDataset(ids)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)
    all_embeds = []
    mean = IMAGENET_MEAN.to(DEVICE)
    std = IMAGENET_STD.to(DEVICE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            batch = batch.to(DEVICE)
            norm_batch = (batch - mean) / std
            flip_batch = torch.flip(norm_batch, dims=[3])
            emb_orig = feature_extractor(norm_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_flip = feature_extractor(flip_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_avg = (emb_orig + emb_flip) / 2.0
            all_embeds.append(emb_avg.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeds, axis=0)


cnn_train_full = extract_cnn_embeddings(train_ids_all)
cnn_test_full = extract_cnn_embeddings(test_ids)

cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[train_idx])
cnn_train_scaled_all = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full)
cnn_test_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full)

n_pca_components = min(100, len(train_idx) - 1, cnn_train_scaled_all.shape[1])
cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca_components, random_state=SEED).fit(
    cnn_train_scaled_all[train_idx]
)
cnn_train_pca_all = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_train_scaled_all)
cnn_test_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_test_scaled)
print(
    f"CNN embedding PCA: {n_pca_components} components explain "
    f"{cnn_pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.4f} of variance (fit on train only)"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Assemble final feature matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
X_train_full = np.concatenate(
    [tabular_train_scaled_all, geo_train_scaled_all, cnn_train_pca_all], axis=1
)
X_test = np.concatenate(
    [tabular_test_scaled, geo_test_scaled, cnn_test_pca], axis=1
).astype(np.float32)

)

print("Feature engineering complete. Artifacts saved to ./working/processed_data.pkl")

# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design (ArcFace embedding network)
# ==================================================================

INPUT_DIM = X_train.shape[1]
NUM_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)
EMBED_DIM = 256
HIDDEN_DIM = 512
DROPOUT = 0.4


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual FC block for a small, low-sample-count tabular embedding net."""

    def __init__(self, dim, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.bn2(self.fc2(out))
        out = out + identity
        return self.act(out)


class LeafEmbeddingNet(nn.Module):
    """Encodes fused tabular+geometric+CNN-PCA features into an L2-normalized embedding."""

    def __init__(
        self, input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(input_dim)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block1 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.block2 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, embed_dim)
        self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_bn(x)
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.embed_bn(x)
        embedding = F.normalize(x, p=2, dim=1)
        return embedding


class ArcMarginProduct(nn.Module):
    """ArcFace additive angular-margin head: widens angular gaps between classes, which matters
    when each of the 99 classes only has ~13 training exemplars to define its region."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_classes, s=30.0, m=0.20):
        super().__init__()
        self.s = s
        self.m = m
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(num_classes, embed_dim))
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight)

    def forward(self, embeddings, labels=None):
        W = F.normalize(self.weight, p=2, dim=1)
        cosine = F.linear(embeddings, W)  # (batch, num_classes), range [-1, 1]
        if labels is None:
            # Inference: no margin injected, plain scaled cosine logits -> softmax probabilities
            return cosine * self.s
        cosine = cosine.clamp(-1 + 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        theta = torch.acos(cosine)
        target_logit = torch.cos(theta + self.m)
        one_hot = torch.zeros_like(cosine)
        one_hot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
        logits = one_hot * target_logit + (1.0 - one_hot) * cosine
        logits = logits * self.s
        return logits


model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
    input_dim=INPUT_DIM, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
).to(DEVICE)
arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
    embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
).to(DEVICE)

# Cross-entropy over ArcFace-margin logits -> softmax probabilities are log-loss compatible.
# Light label smoothing guards against overconfident predictions given the sparse per-class data.
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)

optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
    list(model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
    lr=1e-3,
    weight_decay=1e-4,
)

# Warm restarts help escape sharp minima given the tiny per-class sample count.
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
)

print(
    f"Model design ready -> input_dim={INPUT_DIM}, embed_dim={EMBED_DIM}, "
    f"num_classes={NUM_CLASSES}, device={DEVICE}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

BEST_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_arcface_model.pt")

ALL_CLASS_INDICES = list(range(NUM_CLASSES))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tensors / loaders
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
X_train_t = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float()
y_train_t = torch.from_numpy(y_train).long()
X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(DEVICE)
y_val_np = y_val.astype(np.int64)
X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test).float().to(DEVICE)

BATCH_SIZE = 64
train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, drop_last=False
)

# Light gaussian-noise augmentation on the fused feature vector acts as a regularizer
# against overfitting given the very small per-class sample count (~13 train examples/class).
AUG_NOISE_STD = 0.03

MAX_EPOCHS = 400
PATIENCE = 30
best_val_logloss = np.inf
epochs_no_improve = 0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on true multi-class log-loss
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
    model.train()
    arc_head.train()
    running_loss = 0.0
    n_seen = 0
    for xb, yb in train_loader:
        xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
        yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
        if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
            xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        embeddings = model(xb)
        logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
        loss = criterion(logits, yb)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
        n_seen += xb.size(0)
    scheduler.step()
    train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

    # -------------------- Validation (margin-free cosine softmax) --------------------
    model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(
            val_embeddings, labels=None
        )  # plain scaled cosine, no margin
        val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

    if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
        best_val_logloss = val_logloss
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(
            {"model": model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
            BEST_MODEL_PATH,
        )
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} "
        f"| best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} | no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
    )

    if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
        print(
            f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch} (no improvement for {PATIENCE} epochs)."
        )
        break

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
checkpoint = torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=DEVICE)
model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
model.eval()
arc_head.eval()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final validation metric (official multi-class log-loss, identical inference path as test)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with torch.no_grad():
    val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
    val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
    val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
final_val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference (identical processing/inference logic as validation)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with torch.no_grad():
    test_embeddings = model(X_test_t)
    test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
    test_probs = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = final_val_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os

INPUT_DIR = "./input"

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

RANDOM_STATE = 42
NUM_FOLDS = 5

torch.manual_seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 1: Data processing & feature engineering
# ==================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load raw data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ("id", "species")]
species_classes = sample_sub.columns[
    1:
].tolist()  # authoritative class order for submission

assert (
    train_df[feature_cols].isnull().sum().sum() == 0
), "unexpected NaNs in train tabular features"
assert (
    test_df[feature_cols].isnull().sum().sum() == 0
), "unexpected NaNs in test tabular features"
assert set(train_df["species"].unique()) <= set(
    species_classes
), "species mismatch vs sample_submission"

print(
    f"Loaded train={train_df.shape}, test={test_df.shape}, num_classes={len(species_classes)}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Label encoding (order fixed to sample_submission columns -> no leakage, purely deterministic)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
label_encoder.fit(species_classes)
y_all = label_encoder.transform(train_df["species"].values)
num_classes = len(species_classes)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Image-derived geometric features (extra modality beyond pre-extracted histograms)
#    Row-wise deterministic function of raw pixels -> no fitting, no leakage risk.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
IMAGES_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "images")


def extract_image_features(img_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(img_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return {
            "img_aspect_ratio": np.nan,
            "img_extent": np.nan,
            "img_solidity": np.nan,
            "img_height": np.nan,
            "img_width": np.nan,
            "img_fill_ratio": np.nan,
        }
    h, w = img.shape
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    # foreground (leaf) is the minority-area label (binary leaf-on-white or white-on-black images)
    frac_white = (binary == 255).mean()
    mask = (
        (binary == 255).astype(np.uint8)
        if frac_white < 0.5
        else (binary == 0).astype(np.uint8)
    )
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    if len(xs) == 0:
        return {
            "img_aspect_ratio": np.nan,
            "img_extent": np.nan,
            "img_solidity": np.nan,
            "img_height": h,
            "img_width": w,
            "img_fill_ratio": 0.0,
        }
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max()
    bbox_w, bbox_h = x1 - x0 + 1, y1 - y0 + 1
    leaf_area = float(mask.sum())
    bbox_area = float(bbox_w * bbox_h)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    solidity = np.nan
    if contours:
        biggest = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
        hull_area = cv2.contourArea(cv2.convexHull(biggest))
        if hull_area > 0:
            solidity = leaf_area / hull_area
    return {
        "img_aspect_ratio": bbox_w / bbox_h,
        "img_extent": leaf_area / bbox_area,
        "img_solidity": solidity,
        "img_height": float(h),
        "img_width": float(w),
        "img_fill_ratio": leaf_area / (h * w),
    }


all_ids = pd.concat([train_df["id"], test_df["id"]], ignore_index=True).unique()
img_feat_records = {img_id: extract_image_features(img_id) for img_id in all_ids}
img_feat_df = (
    pd.DataFrame.from_dict(img_feat_records, orient="index")
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"index": "id"})
)
image_feature_cols = [c for c in img_feat_df.columns if c != "id"]

train_df = train_df.merge(img_feat_df, on="id", how="left")
test_df = test_df.merge(img_feat_df, on="id", how="left")
print(
    f"Extracted {len(image_feature_cols)} image-derived geometric features for {len(img_feat_df)} images"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Per-block statistical summary features (row-wise on given histograms, no fitting needed)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
margin_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c.startswith("margin")]
shape_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c.startswith("shape")]
texture_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c.startswith("texture")]


def add_block_stats(df, block_name, cols):
    vals = df[cols].values.astype(np.float64)
    df[f"{block_name}_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
    df[f"{block_name}_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
    df[f"{block_name}_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
    df[f"{block_name}_argmax"] = vals.argmax(axis=1).astype(np.float64)
    eps = 1e-12
    p = vals / (vals.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + eps)
    df[f"{block_name}_entropy"] = -(p * np.log(p + eps)).sum(axis=1)
    return df


for df_ in (train_df, test_df):
    add_block_stats(df_, "margin", margin_cols)
    add_block_stats(df_, "shape", shape_cols)
    add_block_stats(df_, "texture", texture_cols)

engineered_cols = [
    f"{b}_{s}"
    for b in ("margin", "shape", "texture")
    for s in ("mean", "std", "max", "argmax", "entropy")
]

X_cols = feature_cols + engineered_cols + image_feature_cols
print(
    f"Total feature count after engineering: {len(X_cols)} "
    f"({len(feature_cols)} raw + {len(engineered_cols)} block-stats + {len(image_feature_cols)} image)"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Build 5-fold StratifiedKFold splits over the FULL training set
#    (stratified, since only ~9 samples/class -> must preserve class balance).
#    Every sample serves as validation exactly once -> unbiased out-of-fold
#    metric over all 891 samples instead of a noisy 134-sample split.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=NUM_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
fold_indices = list(skf.split(np.zeros(len(y_all)), y_all))

X_all_raw = train_df[X_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
X_test_raw = test_df[X_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Impute (median from fold TRAIN only) + Scale (fit on fold TRAIN only)
#    -> no leakage; done separately PER FOLD so each fold's scaler/median is
#    fit exclusively on that fold's training portion.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fold_data = []
for fold_i, (train_pos, val_pos) in enumerate(fold_indices):
    X_train_fold_raw = X_all_raw.iloc[train_pos].reset_index(drop=True)
    X_val_fold_raw = X_all_raw.iloc[val_pos].reset_index(drop=True)

    fold_median = X_train_fold_raw.median()
    X_train_fold_raw = X_train_fold_raw.fillna(fold_median)
    X_val_fold_raw = X_val_fold_raw.fillna(fold_median)
    X_test_fold_raw = X_test_raw.fillna(fold_median)

    fold_scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_fold = fold_scaler.fit_transform(X_train_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)
    X_val_fold = fold_scaler.transform(X_val_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)
    X_test_fold = fold_scaler.transform(X_test_fold_raw).astype(np.float32)

    fold_data.append(
        {
            "X_train": X_train_fold,
            "X_val": X_val_fold,
            "X_test": X_test_fold,
            "y_train": y_all[train_pos],
            "y_val": y_all[val_pos],
            "train_pos": train_pos,
            "val_pos": val_pos,
            "scaler": fold_scaler,
            "median": fold_median,
        }
    )
    print(
        f"Fold {fold_i}: train={len(train_pos)}, val={len(val_pos)} "
        f"(stratified by species, classes represented in train={len(np.unique(y_all[train_pos]))}/{num_classes}, "
        f"val={len(np.unique(y_all[val_pos]))}/{num_classes})"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Persist processed artifacts for downstream modeling steps
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
joblib.dump(
    {
        "fold_data": fold_data,
        "fold_indices": fold_indices,
        "num_folds": NUM_FOLDS,
        "test_ids": test_ids,
    },
    os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "processed_data.joblib"),
)

joblib.dump(

        "feature_cols": X_cols,
        "num_classes": num_classes,
        "fold_indices": fold_indices,

)

print(
    f"Saved processed_data.joblib -> {NUM_FOLDS} folds, each with "
    f"X_train{fold_data[0]['X_train'].shape}, X_val{fold_data[0]['X_val'].shape}, "
    f"X_test{fold_data[0]['X_test'].shape}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design
