)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation (5-fold dual-modality ensemble)
# ==================================================================

ALL_CLASS_INDICES = list(range(NUM_CLASSES))
N_SPLITS = len(fold_splits)

BATCH_SIZE = 64
# Light gaussian-noise augmentation on the fused feature vector acts as a regularizer
# against overfitting given the very small per-class sample count (~13 train examples/class).
AUG_NOISE_STD = 0.03
MAX_EPOCHS = 150
PATIENCE = 20

IMG_BATCH_SIZE = 48
MAX_EPOCHS_IMG = 8
PATIENCE_IMG = 3

BEST_TAB_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_arcface_model_fold{}.pt")
BEST_IMG_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_image_cnn_fold{}.pt")

oof_probs_tabular = np.zeros((len(train_ids_all), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_probs_image = np.zeros((len(train_ids_all), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_tabular_sum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_image_sum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_filled_mask = np.zeros(len(train_ids_all), dtype=bool)
completed_folds = 0

for fold_idx, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits):
    if fold_idx > 0 and time.time() > TRAIN_DEADLINE:
        print(
            f"\n===== Stopping after {completed_folds} fold(s): wall-clock training "
            f"budget exhausted, preserving time for OOF blend + test inference ====="
        )
        break
    print(
        f"\n===== Fold {fold_idx + 1}/{N_SPLITS} (train={len(tr_idx)}, val={len(va_idx)}) ====="
    )

    # ---------------- Per-fold tabular/geo/CNN-PCA fused features (leakage-free) ----------------
    tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[tr_idx])
    tab_train_scaled_all = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full)
    tab_test_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)

    geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[tr_idx])
    geo_train_scaled_all = geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full)
    geo_test_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)

    cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[tr_idx])
    cnn_train_scaled_all = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full)
    cnn_test_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full)
    cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca_components, random_state=SEED).fit(
        cnn_train_scaled_all[tr_idx]
    )
    cnn_train_pca_all = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_train_scaled_all)
    cnn_test_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_test_scaled)

    X_train_full_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tab_train_scaled_all, geo_train_scaled_all, cnn_train_pca_all], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tab_test_scaled, geo_test_scaled, cnn_test_pca], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_train = X_train_full_fold[tr_idx]
    X_val = X_train_full_fold[va_idx]
    y_train = y_all[tr_idx]
    y_val = y_all[va_idx]

    # ---------------- Tabular ArcFace NN (unchanged architecture/loss/schedule) ----------------
    tab_model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
        input_dim=INPUT_DIM, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)
    arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
    ).to(DEVICE)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        list(tab_model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
    )

    X_train_t = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float()
    y_train_t = torch.from_numpy(y_train).long()
    X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(DEVICE)
    y_val_np = y_val.astype(np.int64)
    X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(DEVICE)

    tab_train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
    tab_train_loader = DataLoader(
        tab_train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    fold_tab_model_path = BEST_TAB_MODEL_PATH.format(fold_idx)
    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        tab_model.train()
        arc_head.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in tab_train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
                xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            embeddings = tab_model(xb)
            logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        tab_model.eval()
        arc_head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_embeddings = tab_model(X_val_t)
            val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
            val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(
                {"model": tab_model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
                fold_tab_model_path,
            )
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epoch % 10 == 0 or epochs_no_improve == 0:
            print(
                f"[tabular fold {fold_idx + 1}] epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
                f"| val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} | best={best_val_logloss:.4f} | no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[tabular fold {fold_idx + 1}] Early stopping at epoch {epoch} "
                f"(no improvement for {PATIENCE} epochs)."
            )
            break

    checkpoint = torch.load(fold_tab_model_path, map_location=DEVICE)
    tab_model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
    tab_model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = tab_model(X_val_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
        fold_val_probs_tab = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        test_embeddings = tab_model(X_test_t)
        test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
        fold_test_probs_tab = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    fold_val_probs_tab = fold_val_probs_tab / fold_val_probs_tab.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )
    fold_test_probs_tab = fold_test_probs_tab / fold_test_probs_tab.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )

    oof_probs_tabular[va_idx] = fold_val_probs_tab
    test_probs_tabular_sum += fold_test_probs_tab

    fold_tab_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val_np,
        np.clip(fold_val_probs_tab, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    print(f"[tabular fold {fold_idx + 1}] final val log-loss: {fold_tab_logloss:.4f}")

    # ---------------- Image CNN branch (fine-tuned resnet18 on raw pixels) ----------------
    img_model = LeafImageCNN(num_classes=NUM_CLASSES).to(DEVICE)
    img_criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    img_optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        [
            {"params": list(img_model.layer4.parameters()), "lr": 1e-4},
            {"params": list(img_model.head.parameters()), "lr": 1e-3},
        ],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    img_scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        img_optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-6
    )

    img_train_dataset = LeafImageTrainDataset(
        train_ids_all[tr_idx], labels=y_all[tr_idx], augment=True
    )
    img_val_dataset = LeafImageTrainDataset(
        train_ids_all[va_idx], labels=y_all[va_idx], augment=False
    )
    img_train_loader = DataLoader(
        img_train_dataset,
        batch_size=IMG_BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        drop_last=False,
    )
    img_val_loader = DataLoader(
        img_val_dataset, batch_size=IMG_BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=2
    )

    fold_img_model_path = BEST_IMG_MODEL_PATH.format(fold_idx)
    best_val_logloss_img = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve_img = 0

    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS_IMG + 1):
        img_model.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in img_train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            img_optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = img_model(xb)
            loss = img_criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            img_optimizer.step()
            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        img_scheduler.step()
        train_loss_img = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        img_model.eval()
        val_probs_list = []
        val_labels_list = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for xb, yb in img_val_loader:
                xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
                logits = img_model(xb)
                probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
                val_probs_list.append(probs)
                val_labels_list.append(yb.numpy())
        val_probs_img = np.concatenate(val_probs_list, axis=0)
        val_labels_img = np.concatenate(val_labels_list, axis=0)
        val_probs_img_clipped = np.clip(val_probs_img, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_img_clipped = val_probs_img_clipped / val_probs_img_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )
        val_logloss_img = log_loss(
            val_labels_img, val_probs_img_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
        )

        if val_logloss_img < best_val_logloss_img:
            best_val_logloss_img = val_logloss_img
            epochs_no_improve_img = 0
            torch.save({"model": img_model.state_dict()}, fold_img_model_path)
        else:
            epochs_no_improve_img += 1

        if epoch % 5 == 0 or epochs_no_improve_img == 0:
            print(
                f"[image fold {fold_idx + 1}] epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss_img:.4f} "
                f"| val_logloss={val_logloss_img:.4f} | best={best_val_logloss_img:.4f} "
                f"| no_improve={epochs_no_improve_img}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve_img >= PATIENCE_IMG:
            print(
                f"[image fold {fold_idx + 1}] Early stopping at epoch {epoch} "
                f"(no improvement for {PATIENCE_IMG} epochs)."
            )
            break

    checkpoint_img = torch.load(fold_img_model_path, map_location=DEVICE)
    img_model.load_state_dict(checkpoint_img["model"])
    img_model.eval()

    fold_val_probs_img = np.zeros((len(va_idx), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    with torch.no_grad():
        offset = 0
        for xb, yb in img_val_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            logits = img_model(xb)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            fold_val_probs_img[offset : offset + probs.shape[0]] = probs
            offset += probs.shape[0]
    fold_val_probs_img = fold_val_probs_img / fold_val_probs_img.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )
    oof_probs_image[va_idx] = fold_val_probs_img

    img_test_dataset = LeafImageTrainDataset(test_ids, labels=None, augment=False)
    img_test_loader = DataLoader(
        img_test_dataset, batch_size=IMG_BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=2
    )
    fold_test_probs_img = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for xb in img_test_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            logits = img_model(xb)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            fold_test_probs_img.append(probs)
    fold_test_probs_img = np.concatenate(fold_test_probs_img, axis=0)
    fold_test_probs_img = fold_test_probs_img / fold_test_probs_img.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )
    test_probs_image_sum += fold_test_probs_img

    fold_img_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val_np,
        np.clip(fold_val_probs_img, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    print(f"[image fold {fold_idx + 1}] final val log-loss: {fold_img_logloss:.4f}")

    oof_filled_mask[va_idx] = True
    completed_folds += 1

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# OOF-optimized blend of the two structurally distinct branches
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs_tabular = test_probs_tabular_sum / completed_folds
test_probs_image = test_probs_image_sum / completed_folds
test_probs_tabular = test_probs_tabular / test_probs_tabular.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs_image = test_probs_image / test_probs_image.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

oof_probs_tabular = np.clip(oof_probs_tabular, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
oof_probs_tabular = oof_probs_tabular / oof_probs_tabular.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
oof_probs_image = np.clip(oof_probs_image, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
oof_probs_image = oof_probs_image / oof_probs_image.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Only score rows whose fold actually completed before the wall-clock deadline,
# so an early stop never fabricates a metric on empty/zero predictions.
y_scored = y_all[oof_filled_mask]
oof_tab_logloss = log_loss(
    y_scored, oof_probs_tabular[oof_filled_mask], labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
)
oof_img_logloss = log_loss(
    y_scored, oof_probs_image[oof_filled_mask], labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
)
print(
    f"\nOOF tabular log-loss: {oof_tab_logloss:.4f} | OOF image log-loss: {oof_img_logloss:.4f}"
)

best_alpha = 1.0
best_blend_logloss = np.inf
for alpha in np.arange(0.0, 1.01, 0.05):
    blended_oof = alpha * oof_probs_tabular + (1.0 - alpha) * oof_probs_image
    blended_oof = blended_oof / blended_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    blended_oof = np.clip(blended_oof, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    blended_oof = blended_oof / blended_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    blend_logloss = log_loss(
        y_scored, blended_oof[oof_filled_mask], labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
    )
    if blend_logloss < best_blend_logloss:
        best_blend_logloss = blend_logloss
        best_alpha = alpha

print(
    f"Best blend alpha (tabular weight): {best_alpha:.2f} | OOF blended log-loss: {best_blend_logloss:.4f}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference: blend 5-fold-averaged probabilities from both branches
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = best_alpha * test_probs_tabular + (1.0 - best_alpha) * test_probs_image
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = best_blend_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# 1. Load raw data

#    keeps every class represented in both folds while giving a real hold-out.

train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(

y_train = y_full[train_idx]

raw_test = test_df[RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Feature engineering — block-level statistical summaries of the
#    pre-extracted margin/shape/texture histograms (mean/std/min/max/skew/
#    kurtosis per 64-dim block). These compress each 64-d distribution into
#    shape-of-distribution descriptors that complement the raw bins.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def block_stats(raw_matrix):
    n = raw_matrix.shape[0]
    stats = np.zeros((n, len(FEATURE_PREFIXES) * 6), dtype=np.float64)
    for b, prefix in enumerate(FEATURE_PREFIXES):
        block = raw_matrix[:, b * 64 : (b + 1) * 64]
        stats[:, b * 6 + 0] = block.mean(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 1] = block.std(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 2] = block.min(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 3] = block.max(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 4] = skew(block, axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 5] = kurtosis(block, axis=1)
    return np.nan_to_num(stats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


stats_train = block_stats(raw_train)
stats_val = block_stats(raw_val)
stats_test = block_stats(raw_test)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Feature engineering — contour-based geometric descriptors extracted
#    directly from the binary leaf silhouette images (rotation/scale
#    invariant): normalized area/perimeter, aspect ratio, extent, solidity,
#    compactness, eccentricity, and 7 log-scaled Hu moments (15 features).
#    This targets whole-silhouette shape cues distinct from the pre-computed
#    contour-signature histograms already present in the tabular data.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_GEOM_FEATURES = 15


def extract_geometric_features(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    img_area = float(img.shape[0] * img.shape[1])
    img_scale = np.sqrt(img_area) if img_area > 0 else 1.0

    # Leaves are dark silhouettes on a white background -> invert so leaf = foreground
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(contour)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(contour)

    aspect_ratio = (w / h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    extent = (area / (w * h)) if (w * h) > 0 else 0.0

    hull = cv2.convexHull(contour)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = (area / hull_area) if hull_area > 0 else 0.0

    area_norm = area / img_area if img_area > 0 else 0.0
    perimeter_norm = perimeter / img_scale if img_scale > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter_norm = (np.sqrt(4.0 * area / np.pi) / img_scale) if area > 0 else 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2 / area) if area > 0 else 0.0

    if len(contour) >= 5:
        (_, _), (major_axis, minor_axis), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(contour)
        major_axis, minor_axis = max(major_axis, minor_axis), min(
            major_axis, minor_axis
        )
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1.0 - (minor_axis / major_axis) ** 2) if major_axis > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0

    moments = cv2.moments(contour)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu_log = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)

    feats = np.array(
        [
            area_norm,
            perimeter_norm,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter_norm,
            compactness,
            eccentricity,
        ]
        + hu_log.tolist(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    return np.nan_to_num(feats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


geom_train = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_split])
geom_val = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in val_ids_split])

CNN_EMBED_DIM = 512
N_CNN_PCA = 50

_cnn_device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
_cnn_backbone = tv_models.resnet18(weights=tv_models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
_cnn_backbone.fc = nn.Identity()
_cnn_backbone.eval()
_cnn_backbone.to(_cnn_device)

_cnn_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.ToPILImage(),
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def extract_cnn_embedding_tta(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(CNN_EMBED_DIM, dtype=np.float64)
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_GRAY2RGB)
    rotations = [
        None,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE,
        cv2.ROTATE_180,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_COUNTERCLOCKWISE,
    ]
    views = []
    for rot in rotations:
        rotated = img_rgb if rot is None else cv2.rotate(img_rgb, rot)
        views.append(rotated)
        views.append(cv2.flip(rotated, 1))
    tensors = torch.stack([_cnn_transform(view) for view in views], dim=0).to(_cnn_device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        embeddings = _cnn_backbone(tensors)
    return embeddings.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64).mean(axis=0)


cnn_embed_train = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in train_ids_split])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model architecture: soft-voting ensemble of multinomial LogisticRegressionCV
# and shrinkage-regularized LinearDiscriminantAnalysis. Chosen instead of
# gradient-boosted trees because with only ~7-9 samples/class against 225
# correlated, standardized features, this dataset (Kaggle Leaf Classification)
# is close to linearly/quadratically separable, so a regularized linear
# boundary + covariance-shrinkage LDA estimate class structure far more
# sample-efficiently than tree splits on individual feature thresholds.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)  # 99 species


def align_proba(raw_proba, classes_seen, n_classes):
    """Re-index predict_proba's columns (ordered by classes_seen) onto the
    full 0..n_classes-1 species space, zero-filling any species that were
    absent from the training fold so val/test always share one fixed
    column layout matching LABEL_COLUMNS order."""
    aligned = np.zeros((raw_proba.shape[0], n_classes), dtype=np.float64)
    for col_idx, cls in enumerate(classes_seen):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = raw_proba[:, col_idx]
    row_sums = aligned.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    return aligned / row_sums


class LinearEnsembleClassifier:
    """Soft-voting ensemble of LogisticRegressionCV + LDA + an RBF-kernel
    SVC + QDA, exposing .fit()/.predict_proba()/.classes_ so downstream code
    (written against a single sklearn-style estimator) needs no further
    changes. QDA's per-class covariance complements LDA/logreg's pooled
    covariance assumption. The four base models' aligned probabilities are
    combined via a fixed, non-negative convex blend (self.blend_weights,
    summing to 1) set via set_blend_weights() after an honest OOF
    coordinate-ascent search, instead of an overparameterized meta-learner
    stacker. Defaults to equal weights until set_blend_weights() is called."""

    def __init__(self, logreg, lda, svc_model, qda_model):
        self.logreg = logreg
        self.lda = lda
        self.svc = svc_model
        self.qda = qda_model
        self.classes_ = None
        self.blend_weights = (0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)

    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.logreg.fit(X, y)
        self.lda.fit(X, y)
        self.svc.fit(X, y)
        self.qda.fit(X, y)
        self.classes_ = self.logreg.classes_
        return self

    def set_blend_weights(self, w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc, w_qda):
        """Store fixed, non-negative convex blend weights (summing to 1)
        chosen via honest OOF log-loss coordinate-ascent search, so the
        combination of the four base models stays tied directly to the
        metric instead of an overparameterized meta-learner."""
        self.blend_weights = (w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc, w_qda)
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        proba_logreg = align_proba(self.logreg.predict_proba(X), self.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_lda = align_proba(self.lda.predict_proba(X), self.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_svc = align_proba(self.svc.predict_proba(X), self.svc.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_qda = align_proba(self.qda.predict_proba(X), self.qda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc, w_qda = self.blend_weights
        combined = (
            w_logreg * proba_logreg + w_lda * proba_lda + w_svc * proba_svc + w_qda * proba_qda
        )
        row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
        return combined / row_sums


class MultiViewProbabilisticEnsemble:
    """Naive-Bayes-style multi-view ensemble mirroring the source dataset
    paper (Mallah, Cope, Orwell), which integrates margin/shape/texture as
    separate probabilistic channels rather than one fused feature vector.
    Holds one shrinkage-regularized LinearDiscriminantAnalysis per
    low-dimensional view (margin/shape/texture/block_stats/geom/cnn) plus
    the existing joint LinearEnsembleClassifier as an additional 'global'
    view. Per-view posteriors are combined via a log-domain weighted
    geometric mean (exp(sum_v w_v * log(clip(p_v))), renormalized per row)
    instead of a linear blend on one fused feature space, since probability
    channels from conditionally-independent feature modalities compose
    multiplicatively, not additively."""

    def __init__(self, global_model):
        self.view_models = {
            view_name: LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")
            for view_name in VIEW_SLICES
        }
        self.global_model = global_model
        self.classes_ = None
        all_channels = list(self.view_models.keys()) + ["global", "qda"]
        self.view_weights = {ch: 1.0 / len(all_channels) for ch in all_channels}

    def fit(self, view_dict, y):
        for view_name, view_model in self.view_models.items():
            view_model.fit(view_dict[view_name], y)
        self.global_model.fit(view_dict["global"], y)
        self.classes_ = self.global_model.classes_
        return self

    def set_view_weights(self, weights_dict):
        """Store fixed, non-negative log-domain fusion weights (normalized
        to sum to 1) chosen via honest OOF log-loss coordinate search over
        the per-view LDA posteriors plus the joint model's 'global' view."""
        self.view_weights = dict(weights_dict)
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, view_dict):
        n_rows = view_dict["global"].shape[0]
        log_combined = np.zeros((n_rows, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
        for view_name, view_model in self.view_models.items():
            w = self.view_weights.get(view_name, 0.0)
            if w > 0.0:
                proba = align_proba(
                    view_model.predict_proba(view_dict[view_name]), view_model.classes_, N_CLASSES
                )
                log_combined += w * np.log(np.clip(proba, 1e-15, 1.0))
        w_global = self.view_weights.get("global", 0.0)
        if w_global > 0.0:
            proba_global = align_proba(
                self.global_model.predict_proba(view_dict["global"]), self.global_model.classes_, N_CLASSES
            )
            log_combined += w_global * np.log(np.clip(proba_global, 1e-15, 1.0))
        w_qda = self.view_weights.get("qda", 0.0)
        if w_qda > 0.0:
            proba_qda = align_proba(
                self.global_model.qda.predict_proba(view_dict["global"]), self.global_model.qda.classes_, N_CLASSES
            )
            log_combined += w_qda * np.log(np.clip(proba_qda, 1e-15, 1.0))
        combined = np.exp(log_combined)
        row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
        return combined / row_sums


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SVC C/gamma tuning: honest OOF log-loss grid search over the same 5-fold
# StratifiedKFold split used below for the logreg/lda/svc OOF arrays. The RBF
# kernel width (gamma) and margin penalty (C) are tuned jointly since some
# classes have only ~6-8 samples per fold and an untuned kernel SVM can
# over- or under-fit the class boundaries.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
kfold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
SVC_C_GRID = [0.1, 1, 10, 100]
SVC_GAMMA_GRID = ["scale", 0.01, 0.001]
best_svc_C = SVC_C_GRID[0]
best_svc_gamma = SVC_GAMMA_GRID[0]
best_svc_loss = np.inf
for C_cand in SVC_C_GRID:
    for gamma_cand in SVC_GAMMA_GRID:
        oof_svc_cand_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
        for fold_train_idx, fold_holdout_idx in kfold.split(X_train, y_train):
            svc_cand = SVC(
                kernel="rbf",
                probability=True,
                decision_function_shape="ovr",
                random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                C=C_cand,
                gamma=gamma_cand,
            )
            svc_cand.fit(X_train[fold_train_idx], y_train[fold_train_idx])
            oof_svc_cand_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
                svc_cand.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), svc_cand.classes_, N_CLASSES
            )
        svc_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_svc_cand_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
        print(f"SVC C={C_cand}, gamma={gamma_cand}: OOF log_loss={svc_loss:.5f}")
        if svc_loss < best_svc_loss:
            best_svc_loss = svc_loss
            best_svc_C = C_cand
            best_svc_gamma = gamma_cand
print(f"Selected SVC C={best_svc_C}, gamma={best_svc_gamma} (OOF log_loss={best_svc_loss:.5f})")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# QDA reg_param tuning: honest OOF log-loss grid search over the same 5-fold
# StratifiedKFold split used for SVC, mirroring that pattern. QDA estimates a
# separate covariance per class (unlike LDA/logreg's pooled covariance), so
# its shrinkage-toward-pooled reg_param is tuned the same way.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
QDA_REG_PARAM_GRID = [0.0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
best_qda_reg_param = QDA_REG_PARAM_GRID[0]
best_qda_loss = np.inf
for reg_param_cand in QDA_REG_PARAM_GRID:
    oof_qda_cand_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for fold_train_idx, fold_holdout_idx in kfold.split(X_train, y_train):
        qda_cand = QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis(reg_param=reg_param_cand)
        qda_cand.fit(X_train[fold_train_idx], y_train[fold_train_idx])
        oof_qda_cand_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
            qda_cand.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), qda_cand.classes_, N_CLASSES
        )
    qda_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_qda_cand_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
    print(f"QDA reg_param={reg_param_cand}: OOF log_loss={qda_loss:.5f}")
    if qda_loss < best_qda_loss:
        best_qda_loss = qda_loss
        best_qda_reg_param = reg_param_cand
print(f"Selected QDA reg_param={best_qda_reg_param} (OOF log_loss={best_qda_loss:.5f})")

global_model = LinearEnsembleClassifier(
    LogisticRegressionCV(
        Cs=np.logspace(-4, 2, 20),
        cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3),
        multi_class="multinomial",
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=5000,
        penalty="l2",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    ),
    LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto"),
    SVC(
        kernel="rbf",
        probability=True,
        decision_function_shape="ovr",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        C=best_svc_C,
        gamma=best_svc_gamma,
    ),
    QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis(reg_param=best_qda_reg_param),
)
model = MultiViewProbabilisticEnsemble(global_model)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss function: multinomial (softmax) cross-entropy / log-loss over the 99
# species — this is LightGBM's built-in "multi_logloss" objective used
# internally during boosting, and is algebraically identical to the official
# competition metric. We expose the same formula explicitly via sklearn's
# log_loss for auditable validation scoring in the training step:
#   log_loss(y_true, model.predict_proba(X), labels=range(N_CLASSES))
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
criterion = log_loss

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# "Optimizer": no separate optimizer object here either — LogisticRegressionCV's
# lbfgs solver picks its per-class regularization strength C via 3-fold CV
# over the Cs grid, while LDA has no iterative optimizer at all (closed-form
# class means / pooled covariance with analytic shrinkage). The
# regularization search + shrinkage estimate ARE this ensemble's analogue of
# an optimizer schedule.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
optimizer_config = {
    "logreg_Cs_grid": "logspace(-4, 2, 20)",
    "logreg_cv_folds": 3,
    "lda_shrinkage": "auto",
    "svc_C_grid": SVC_C_GRID,
    "svc_gamma_grid": SVC_GAMMA_GRID,
    "svc_C_selected": best_svc_C,
    "svc_gamma_selected": best_svc_gamma,
    "qda_reg_param_grid": QDA_REG_PARAM_GRID,
    "qda_reg_param_selected": best_qda_reg_param,
    "eval_metric": "multi_logloss",
}

print(
    f"Model: LogisticRegressionCV + LDA + SVC (RBF) + QDA stacking ensemble | classes={N_CLASSES} | features={len(FEATURE_NAMES)}"
)
print(
    f"Loss: multinomial log-loss (multi_logloss) | Optimizer: {optimizer_config}"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training: fit both linear sub-models directly (no boosting iterations to
# stage-log here). Report each sub-model's chosen regularization and its own
# held-out log-loss so the ensemble's validation path stays auditable.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.fit(view_train_full, y_train)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5-fold OOF bagging: train a fresh (LogisticRegressionCV, LDA) pair per
# fold on that fold's training subset, collect out-of-fold aligned
# probabilities on the held-out rows (assembled in X_train's row order), use
# the full OOF arrays to tune the ensemble blend weight alpha via honest
# log-loss grid search, and keep all 5 fold-model pairs to bag the final
# X_val/X_test predictions (variance reduction versus any single fit given
# ~7-9 samples/class).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_logreg_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_lda_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_svc_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_qda_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_view_proba = {
    view_name: np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64) for view_name in VIEW_SLICES
}
fold_models = []

for fold_idx, (fold_train_idx, fold_holdout_idx) in enumerate(kfold.split(X_train, y_train)):
    fold_global_model = LinearEnsembleClassifier(
        LogisticRegressionCV(
            Cs=np.logspace(-4, 2, 20),
            cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3),
            multi_class="multinomial",
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=5000,
            penalty="l2",
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        ),
        LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto"),
        SVC(
            kernel="rbf",
            probability=True,
            decision_function_shape="ovr",
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
            C=best_svc_C,
            gamma=best_svc_gamma,
        ),
        QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis(reg_param=best_qda_reg_param),
    )
    fold_model = MultiViewProbabilisticEnsemble(fold_global_model)
    fold_view_dict_train = {view_name: view_train[view_name][fold_train_idx] for view_name in VIEW_SLICES}
    fold_view_dict_train["global"] = X_train[fold_train_idx]
    fold_view_dict_holdout = {view_name: view_train[view_name][fold_holdout_idx] for view_name in VIEW_SLICES}
    fold_view_dict_holdout["global"] = X_train[fold_holdout_idx]
    fold_model.fit(fold_view_dict_train, y_train[fold_train_idx])
    oof_logreg_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
        fold_model.global_model.logreg.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), fold_model.global_model.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES
    )
    oof_lda_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
        fold_model.global_model.lda.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), fold_model.global_model.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES
    )
    oof_svc_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
        fold_model.global_model.svc.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), fold_model.global_model.svc.classes_, N_CLASSES
    )
    oof_qda_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
        fold_model.global_model.qda.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), fold_model.global_model.qda.classes_, N_CLASSES
    )
    for view_name, view_model in fold_model.view_models.items():
        oof_view_proba[view_name][fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
            view_model.predict_proba(fold_view_dict_holdout[view_name]), view_model.classes_, N_CLASSES
        )
    fold_models.append(fold_model)
    print(f"Fold {fold_idx + 1}/5: trained on {len(fold_train_idx)} rows, held out {len(fold_holdout_idx)} rows")

# Cross-validated weight-selection: score every weight candidate on the MEAN
# log-loss across 5 stratified folds of ALL 712 training rows (instead of a
# single ~213-row inner holdout), so the blend-weight grid search and the
# multi-view coordinate search both use ~3.3x more rows and are far less
# sensitive to sampling noise in any one split. A small L2 shrinkage penalty
# toward uniform weights is added to the mean CV log-loss before comparing
# candidates, biasing ties away from extreme, noise-fitting weight vectors.
weight_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
weight_cv_folds = list(weight_cv.split(np.arange(X_train.shape[0]), y_train))
WEIGHT_SHRINKAGE_LAMBDA = 0.02


def mean_cv_log_loss(proba_matrix):
    fold_losses = [
        log_loss(y_train[fold_holdout], proba_matrix[fold_holdout], labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
        for _, fold_holdout in weight_cv_folds
    ]
    return float(np.mean(fold_losses))


def normalize_channel_weights(weights):
    total = sum(weights.values())
    if total <= 0:
        return {ch: 1.0 / len(weights) for ch in weights}
    return {ch: w / total for ch, w in weights.items()}


view_weight_grid = [0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]


def combine_linear_blend(channel_proba, weights):
    combined = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for ch, proba in channel_proba.items():
        w = weights.get(ch, 0.0)
        if w > 0.0:
            combined += w * proba
    row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    return combined / row_sums


def blend_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(channel_proba, weights):
    combined = combine_linear_blend(channel_proba, weights)
    n_channels = len(weights)
    shrinkage_penalty = WEIGHT_SHRINKAGE_LAMBDA * sum(
        (w - 1.0 / n_channels) ** 2 for w in weights.values()
    )
    return mean_cv_log_loss(combined) + shrinkage_penalty


# Coordinate-ascent search (the same scheme used for the multi-view fusion
# weights below) over the 4-way blend simplex that minimizes cross-validated
# OOF log-loss plus shrinkage penalty. Replaces the exhaustive nested-loop
# grid search, which only scaled to 3 weights, now that QDA is a 4th base
# learner in the ensemble.
BLEND_CHANNEL_NAMES = ["logreg", "lda", "svc", "qda"]
oof_blend_channel_proba = {
    "logreg": oof_logreg_proba,
    "lda": oof_lda_proba,
    "svc": oof_svc_proba,
    "qda": oof_qda_proba,
}
current_blend_weights = normalize_channel_weights({ch: 1.0 for ch in BLEND_CHANNEL_NAMES})
current_blend_loss = blend_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(oof_blend_channel_proba, current_blend_weights)
for pass_idx in range(3):
    improved = False
    for ch in BLEND_CHANNEL_NAMES:
        best_ch_weights = current_blend_weights
        best_ch_loss = current_blend_loss
        for cand in view_weight_grid:
            trial_weights = normalize_channel_weights({**current_blend_weights, ch: cand})
            trial_loss = blend_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(oof_blend_channel_proba, trial_weights)
            if trial_loss < best_ch_loss:
                best_ch_loss = trial_loss
                best_ch_weights = trial_weights
        if best_ch_loss < current_blend_loss:
            current_blend_weights = best_ch_weights
            current_blend_loss = best_ch_loss
            improved = True
    if not improved:
        break

best_weights = current_blend_weights
best_loss = current_blend_loss
w1, w2, w3, w4 = (
    best_weights["logreg"],
    best_weights["lda"],
    best_weights["svc"],
    best_weights["qda"],
)
print(f'Best blend weights: logreg={w1:.2f}, lda={w2:.2f}, svc={w3:.2f}, qda={w4:.2f}, mean_cv_log_loss(+shrinkage)={best_loss:.5f}')
model.global_model.set_blend_weights(w1, w2, w3, w4)
for fold_model in fold_models:
    fold_model.global_model.set_blend_weights(w1, w2, w3, w4)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Multi-view log-domain fusion weight tuning: honest OOF log-loss coordinate
# search over the 6 per-view LDA posteriors plus the joint model's blended
# 'global' view (7 channels total), replacing the flexible 495-input
# stacker that catastrophically overfit in a prior attempt. Weights combine
# via a weighted geometric mean in log-domain (conditionally-independent
# probability channels compose multiplicatively) rather than another linear
# blend on the same joint feature space.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_global_proba = w1 * oof_logreg_proba + w2 * oof_lda_proba + w3 * oof_svc_proba + w4 * oof_qda_proba
_global_row_sums = oof_global_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
_global_row_sums[_global_row_sums == 0] = 1.0
oof_global_proba = oof_global_proba / _global_row_sums

oof_channel_proba = dict(oof_view_proba)
oof_channel_proba["global"] = oof_global_proba
oof_channel_proba["qda"] = oof_qda_proba
CHANNEL_NAMES = list(VIEW_SLICES.keys()) + ["global", "qda"]


def combine_log_domain(channel_proba, weights):
    log_combined = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for ch, proba in channel_proba.items():
        w = weights.get(ch, 0.0)
        if w > 0.0:
            log_combined += w * np.log(np.clip(proba, 1e-15, 1.0))
    combined = np.exp(log_combined)
    row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    return combined / row_sums


def view_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(channel_proba, weights):
    combined = combine_log_domain(channel_proba, weights)
    n_channels = len(weights)
    shrinkage_penalty = WEIGHT_SHRINKAGE_LAMBDA * sum(
        (w - 1.0 / n_channels) ** 2 for w in weights.values()
    )
    return mean_cv_log_loss(combined) + shrinkage_penalty


current_view_weights = normalize_channel_weights({ch: 1.0 for ch in CHANNEL_NAMES})
current_view_loss = view_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(oof_channel_proba, current_view_weights)
for pass_idx in range(3):
    improved = False
    for ch in CHANNEL_NAMES:
        best_ch_weights = current_view_weights
        best_ch_loss = current_view_loss
        for cand in view_weight_grid:
            trial_weights = normalize_channel_weights({**current_view_weights, ch: cand})
            trial_loss = view_weight_cv_shrinkage_loss(oof_channel_proba, trial_weights)
            if trial_loss < best_ch_loss:
                best_ch_loss = trial_loss
                best_ch_weights = trial_weights
        if best_ch_loss < current_view_loss:
            current_view_weights = best_ch_weights
            current_view_loss = best_ch_loss
            improved = True
    if not improved:
        break

best_view_weights = current_view_weights
best_view_loss = current_view_loss
print(f"Best multi-view weights: {best_view_weights}, mean_cv_log_loss(+shrinkage)={best_view_loss:.5f}")
model.set_view_weights(best_view_weights)
for fold_model in fold_models:
    fold_model.set_view_weights(best_view_weights)

oof_logreg_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_logreg_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
oof_lda_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_lda_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
oof_svc_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_svc_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
oof_qda_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_qda_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
print(f"OOF LogisticRegressionCV: log_loss={oof_logreg_loss:.5f}")
print(f"OOF LinearDiscriminantAnalysis: log_loss={oof_lda_loss:.5f}")
print(f"OOF SVC (RBF): log_loss={oof_svc_loss:.5f}")
print(f"OOF QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis: log_loss={oof_qda_loss:.5f}")
print("Training complete: 5 fold model-quadruples fitted for bagging, stacking meta-learner trained via OOF probabilities")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the best model (state at best_iteration_, captured automatically by
# LightGBM's early-stopping bookkeeping) and reload it for inference, so
# validation scoring and test-set prediction both run through the exact
# persisted artifact rather than the in-memory object mutated during fit().
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEST_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_lgbm_model.pkl")
joblib.dump(model, BEST_MODEL_PATH)
best_model = joblib.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation: average the alpha-blended, aligned probabilities of the 5
# fold-model pairs (bagging), using only already-fitted folds/scaler — no
# leakage from val/test into training. align_proba/N_CLASSES are defined
# above with model.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
val_probs = np.mean([fold_model.predict_proba(view_val_full) for fold_model in fold_models], axis=0)
val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Official competition metric: multi-class log-loss over ALL 99 species,
# with labels fixed to the full 0..98 range so the formula matches the
# evaluation section exactly even if a species was missing from a fold.
score = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference: same 5 fold-model pairs, same align_proba post-processing
# and bagged alpha-blended averaging as validation.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = np.mean([fold_model.predict_proba(view_test_full) for fold_model in fold_models], axis=0)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_df = submission_df[["id"] + LABEL_COLUMNS]

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved submission with shape {submission_df.shape} to {submission_path}")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os

# 1. Load raw data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

species_to_idx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS)}
idx_to_species = {i: s for s, i in species_to_idx.items()}

TABULAR_COLS = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ("id", "species")]
assert TABULAR_COLS == [c for c in test_df.columns if c != "id"]

y_all = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values.astype(np.int64)
train_ids_all = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

print(
    f"Train rows: {len(train_df)}, Test rows: {len(test_df)}, Classes: {len(LABEL_COLUMNS)}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified K-fold split (leakage-free; every row is validation exactly once)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class_counts = pd.Series(y_all).value_counts()
min_class_count = class_counts.min()
N_SPLITS = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
fold_splits = list(skf.split(np.arange(len(train_df)), y_all))
print(
    f"K-fold -> {N_SPLITS} folds over {len(train_df)} rows (min class count in full train: {min_class_count})"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Tabular features: raw 192-dim descriptors + per-family summary stats
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def add_family_stats(df):
    feats = {}
    family_vals = {}
    for family in ("margin", "shape", "texture"):
        cols = [c for c in TABULAR_COLS if c.startswith(family)]
        vals = df[cols].values
        family_vals[family] = vals
        feats[f"{family}_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_argmax"] = vals.argmax(axis=1).astype(float)

    margin_vals = family_vals["margin"]
    shape_vals = family_vals["shape"]
    texture_vals = family_vals["texture"]
    n_common = min(margin_vals.shape[1], shape_vals.shape[1])
    row_corr = np.array(
        [
            np.corrcoef(margin_vals[i, :n_common], shape_vals[i, :n_common])[0, 1]
            for i in range(len(df))
        ]
    )
    row_corr = np.nan_to_num(row_corr, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    feats["margin_shape_mean_prod"] = feats["margin_mean"] * feats["shape_mean"]
    feats["margin_shape_std_ratio"] = feats["margin_std"] / (feats["shape_std"] + 1e-6)
    feats["texture_shape_mean_prod"] = feats["texture_mean"] * feats["shape_mean"]
    feats["margin_shape_row_corr"] = row_corr
    return pd.DataFrame(feats, index=df.index)


train_stats = add_family_stats(train_df)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Hand-crafted geometric / Hu-moment shape features from raw images
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
GEO_DIM = 16


def extract_geometric_features(img_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    c = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(c)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(c)
    aspect_ratio = w / float(h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    rect_area = w * h
    extent = area / rect_area if rect_area > 0 else 0.0
    hull = cv2.convexHull(c)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = area / hull_area if hull_area > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter = np.sqrt(4 * area / np.pi) if area > 0 else 0.0
    if len(c) >= 5:
        _, (MA, ma), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(c)
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1 - (min(MA, ma) / max(MA, ma)) ** 2) if max(MA, ma) > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2) / area if area > 0 else 0.0
    circularity = 4 * np.pi * area / (perimeter**2) if perimeter > 0 else 0.0
    moments = cv2.moments(c)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)
    geo = np.array(
        [
            area,
            perimeter,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter,
            eccentricity,
            compactness,
            circularity,
        ],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    return np.concatenate([geo, hu.astype(np.float32)])


geo_train_full = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_all])

IMG_SIZE = 128

class LeafImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids):
        self.ids = ids

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if img is None:
            img = np.zeros((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.resize(img, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        tensor = torch.from_numpy(img).float().unsqueeze(0) / 255.0
        tensor = tensor.repeat(3, 1, 1)
        return tensor

except Exception:

    except Exception:

feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(*list(backbone.children())[:-1]).to(DEVICE).eval()
for p in feature_extractor.parameters():
    p.requires_grad_(False)


def extract_cnn_embeddings(ids):
    dataset = LeafImageDataset(ids)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)
    all_embeds = []
    mean = IMAGENET_MEAN.to(DEVICE)
    std = IMAGENET_STD.to(DEVICE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            batch = batch.to(DEVICE)
            norm_batch = (batch - mean) / std
            flip_batch = torch.flip(norm_batch, dims=[3])
            emb_orig = feature_extractor(norm_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_flip = feature_extractor(flip_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_avg = (emb_orig + emb_flip) / 2.0
            all_embeds.append(emb_avg.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeds, axis=0)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design (ArcFace embedding network + HistGradientBoosting branch)
# ==================================================================

CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS = 100
INPUT_DIM = tabular_train_full.shape[1] + geo_train_full.shape[1] + CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS
NUM_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)
EMBED_DIM = 256
HIDDEN_DIM = 512
DROPOUT = 0.4


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual FC block for a small, low-sample-count tabular embedding net."""

    def __init__(self, dim, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.bn2(self.fc2(out))
        out = out + identity
        return self.act(out)


class LeafEmbeddingNet(nn.Module):
    """Encodes fused tabular+geometric+CNN-PCA features into an L2-normalized embedding."""

    def __init__(
        self, input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(input_dim)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block1 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.block2 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, embed_dim)
        self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_bn(x)
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.embed_bn(x)
        embedding = F.normalize(x, p=2, dim=1)
        return embedding


class ArcMarginProduct(nn.Module):
    """ArcFace additive angular-margin head: widens angular gaps between classes, which matters
    when each of the 99 classes only has ~13 training exemplars to define its region."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_classes, s=30.0, m=0.20):
        super().__init__()
        self.s = s
        self.m = m
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(num_classes, embed_dim))
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight)

    def forward(self, embeddings, labels=None):
        W = F.normalize(self.weight, p=2, dim=1)
        cosine = F.linear(embeddings, W)  # (batch, num_classes), range [-1, 1]
        if labels is None:
            # Inference: no margin injected, plain scaled cosine logits -> softmax probabilities
            return cosine * self.s
        cosine = cosine.clamp(-1 + 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        theta = torch.acos(cosine)
        target_logit = torch.cos(theta + self.m)
        one_hot = torch.zeros_like(cosine)
        one_hot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
        logits = one_hot * target_logit + (1.0 - one_hot) * cosine
        logits = logits * self.s
        return logits


def build_nn_components():
    model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
        input_dim=INPUT_DIM, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)
    arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
    ).to(DEVICE)
    # Cross-entropy over ArcFace-margin logits -> softmax probabilities are log-loss compatible.
    # Light label smoothing guards against overconfident predictions given the sparse per-class data.
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        list(model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    # Warm restarts help escape sharp minima given the tiny per-class sample count.
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    return model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler


def build_gbdt():
    return HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
        max_iter=300,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_leaf_nodes=15,
        min_samples_leaf=5,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=SEED,
    )


print(
    f"Model design ready -> input_dim={INPUT_DIM}, embed_dim={EMBED_DIM}, "
    f"num_classes={NUM_CLASSES}, device={DEVICE}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

BEST_MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_arcface_model.pt")

ALL_CLASS_INDICES = list(range(NUM_CLASSES))
N_ROWS = len(y_all)

BATCH_SIZE = 64
# Light gaussian-noise augmentation on the fused feature vector acts as a regularizer
# against overfitting given the very small per-class sample count (~13 train examples/class).
AUG_NOISE_STD = 0.03
MAX_EPOCHS = 400
PATIENCE = 30

oof_probs_nn = np.zeros((N_ROWS, NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_probs_gbdt = np.zeros((N_ROWS, NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_nn_accum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_gbdt_accum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# K-fold loop: per-fold scaling/PCA, ArcFace NN + HistGradientBoosting branches
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for fold_i, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits, start=1):
    y_train = y_all[tr_idx]
    y_val = y_all[va_idx]

    tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[tr_idx])
    tabular_train_scaled_all = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full)
    tabular_test_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)

    geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[tr_idx])
    geo_train_scaled_all = geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full)
    geo_test_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)

    cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[tr_idx])
    cnn_train_scaled_all = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full)
    cnn_test_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full)

    n_pca_components = min(
        CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS, len(tr_idx) - 1, cnn_train_scaled_all.shape[1]
    )
    cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca_components, random_state=SEED).fit(
        cnn_train_scaled_all[tr_idx]
    )
    cnn_train_pca_all = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_train_scaled_all)
    cnn_test_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_test_scaled)
    if n_pca_components < CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS:
        pad = CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS - n_pca_components
        cnn_train_pca_all = np.pad(cnn_train_pca_all, ((0, 0), (0, pad)))
        cnn_test_pca = np.pad(cnn_test_pca, ((0, 0), (0, pad)))

    X_train_full_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_train_scaled_all, geo_train_scaled_all, cnn_train_pca_all], axis=1
    )
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_test_scaled, geo_test_scaled, cnn_test_pca], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_train = X_train_full_fold[tr_idx].astype(np.float32)
    X_val = X_train_full_fold[va_idx].astype(np.float32)

    print(
        f"[Fold {fold_i}/{len(fold_splits)}] train: {X_train.shape}, val: {X_val.shape}, "
        f"test: {X_test_fold.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------- ArcFace NN branch --------------------
    model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler = build_nn_components()

    X_train_t = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float()
    y_train_t = torch.from_numpy(y_train).long()
    X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(DEVICE)
    y_val_np = y_val.astype(np.int64)
    X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(DEVICE)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    # -------------------- Training loop with early stopping on true multi-class log-loss --------------------
    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        arc_head.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
                xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            embeddings = model(xb)
            logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        # -------------------- Validation (margin-free cosine softmax) --------------------
        model.eval()
        arc_head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
            val_logits = arc_head(
                val_embeddings, labels=None
            )  # plain scaled cosine, no margin
            val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(
                {"model": model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
                BEST_MODEL_PATH,
            )
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epoch % 20 == 0 or epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[Fold {fold_i}] Epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | "
                f"val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} | best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} "
                f"| no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[Fold {fold_i}] Early stopping at epoch {epoch} (no improvement for {PATIENCE} epochs)."
            )
            break

    # -------------------- Load best checkpoint --------------------
    checkpoint = torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=DEVICE)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
    model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
        val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    oof_probs_nn[va_idx] = val_probs

    with torch.no_grad():
        test_embeddings = model(X_test_t)
        test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
        test_probs_nn = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    test_probs_nn = test_probs_nn / test_probs_nn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    test_probs_nn_accum += test_probs_nn

    # -------------------- HistGradientBoosting branch --------------------
    gbdt = build_gbdt()
    gbdt.fit(X_train, y_train)

    gbdt_val_probs = gbdt.predict_proba(X_val)
    gbdt_val_full = np.zeros((len(va_idx), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    gbdt_val_full[:, gbdt.classes_] = gbdt_val_probs
    oof_probs_gbdt[va_idx] = gbdt_val_full

    gbdt_test_probs = gbdt.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    gbdt_test_full = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    gbdt_test_full[:, gbdt.classes_] = gbdt_test_probs
    test_probs_gbdt_accum += gbdt_test_full

    fold_nn_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val,
        np.clip(oof_probs_nn[va_idx], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    fold_gbdt_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val,
        np.clip(oof_probs_gbdt[va_idx], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    print(
        f"[Fold {fold_i}] NN val_logloss={fold_nn_logloss:.4f} | GBDT val_logloss={fold_gbdt_logloss:.4f}"
    )

test_probs_nn_avg = test_probs_nn_accum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_gbdt_avg = test_probs_gbdt_accum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_nn_avg = test_probs_nn_avg / test_probs_nn_avg.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs_gbdt_avg = test_probs_gbdt_avg / test_probs_gbdt_avg.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grid-search blend weight against true OOF log-loss (official metric, leakage-free)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
best_alpha = None
best_blend_logloss = np.inf
for alpha in np.arange(0, 1.01, 0.05):
    blended_oof = alpha * oof_probs_nn + (1 - alpha) * oof_probs_gbdt
    blended_oof = blended_oof / blended_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    blended_oof = np.clip(blended_oof, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    blend_logloss = log_loss(y_all, blended_oof, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)
    if blend_logloss < best_blend_logloss:
        best_blend_logloss = blend_logloss
        best_alpha = alpha

print(
    f"Best blend alpha (NN weight): {best_alpha:.2f} | OOF log-loss: {best_blend_logloss:.4f}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final test predictions using the OOF-optimal blend weight
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = best_alpha * test_probs_nn_avg + (1 - best_alpha) * test_probs_gbdt_avg
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = best_blend_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load raw data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(

y_train = y_full[train_idx]

raw_train = train_df.iloc[train_idx][RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)

raw_test = test_df[RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Feature engineering — block-level statistical summaries of the
#    pre-extracted margin/shape/texture histograms (mean/std/min/max/skew/
#    kurtosis per 64-dim block). These compress each 64-d distribution into
#    shape-of-distribution descriptors that complement the raw bins.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def block_stats(raw_matrix):
    n = raw_matrix.shape[0]
    stats = np.zeros((n, len(FEATURE_PREFIXES) * 6), dtype=np.float64)
    for b, prefix in enumerate(FEATURE_PREFIXES):
        block = raw_matrix[:, b * 64 : (b + 1) * 64]
        stats[:, b * 6 + 0] = block.mean(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 1] = block.std(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 2] = block.min(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 3] = block.max(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 4] = skew(block, axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 5] = kurtosis(block, axis=1)
    return np.nan_to_num(stats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


stats_train = block_stats(raw_train)
stats_val = block_stats(raw_val)
stats_test = block_stats(raw_test)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Feature engineering — contour-based geometric descriptors extracted
#    directly from the binary leaf silhouette images (rotation/scale
#    invariant): normalized area/perimeter, aspect ratio, extent, solidity,
#    compactness, eccentricity, and 7 log-scaled Hu moments (15 features).
#    This targets whole-silhouette shape cues distinct from the pre-computed
#    contour-signature histograms already present in the tabular data.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_GEOM_FEATURES = 15


def extract_geometric_features(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    img_area = float(img.shape[0] * img.shape[1])
    img_scale = np.sqrt(img_area) if img_area > 0 else 1.0

    # Leaves are dark silhouettes on a white background -> invert so leaf = foreground
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(contour)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(contour)

    aspect_ratio = (w / h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    extent = (area / (w * h)) if (w * h) > 0 else 0.0

    hull = cv2.convexHull(contour)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = (area / hull_area) if hull_area > 0 else 0.0

    area_norm = area / img_area if img_area > 0 else 0.0
    perimeter_norm = perimeter / img_scale if img_scale > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter_norm = (np.sqrt(4.0 * area / np.pi) / img_scale) if area > 0 else 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2 / area) if area > 0 else 0.0

    if len(contour) >= 5:
        (_, _), (major_axis, minor_axis), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(contour)
        major_axis, minor_axis = max(major_axis, minor_axis), min(
            major_axis, minor_axis
        )
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1.0 - (minor_axis / major_axis) ** 2) if major_axis > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0

    moments = cv2.moments(contour)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu_log = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)

    feats = np.array(
        [
            area_norm,
            perimeter_norm,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter_norm,
            compactness,
            eccentricity,
        ]
        + hu_log.tolist(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    return np.nan_to_num(feats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


geom_train = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_split])
geom_val = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in val_ids_split])
geom_test = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in test_ids])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4b. Feature engineering — frozen ImageNet-pretrained CNN (resnet18)
#     embeddings. The 15 whole-silhouette geometric descriptors above miss
#     localized texture/margin micro-patterns that pretrained CNN filters
#     detect; with ~9 samples/class fine-tuning would overfit, so the
#     backbone stays frozen (eval mode, no_grad) and only a train-fit PCA is
#     learned on top of its embeddings.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CNN_EMBED_DIM = 512
N_CNN_PCA = 50

_cnn_device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
_cnn_backbone = tv_models.resnet18(weights=tv_models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
_cnn_backbone.fc = nn.Identity()
_cnn_backbone.eval()
_cnn_backbone.to(_cnn_device)

_cnn_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.ToPILImage(),
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def extract_cnn_embedding_tta(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(CNN_EMBED_DIM, dtype=np.float64)
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_GRAY2RGB)
    rotations = [
        None,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE,
        cv2.ROTATE_180,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_COUNTERCLOCKWISE,
    ]
    views = []
    for rot in rotations:
        rotated = img_rgb if rot is None else cv2.rotate(img_rgb, rot)
        views.append(rotated)
        views.append(cv2.flip(rotated, 1))
    tensors = torch.stack([_cnn_transform(view) for view in views], dim=0).to(_cnn_device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        embeddings = _cnn_backbone(tensors)
    return embeddings.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64).mean(axis=0)


cnn_embed_train = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in train_ids_split])
cnn_embed_val = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in val_ids_split])
cnn_embed_test = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in test_ids])

cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=N_CNN_PCA, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
cnn_pca.fit(cnn_embed_train)
cnn_train = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_train)
cnn_val = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_val)
cnn_test = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_test)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Assemble full feature matrices and fit scaling ONLY on the training fold
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        "solidity",

        "eccentricity",

    + [f"hu_log_{i}" for i in range(7)]

)
assert X_train_raw.shape[1] == len(FEATURE_NAMES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5b. Multi-view feature blocks: instead of only the globally-scaled,
# concatenated 415-dim matrix (which forces covariance-based estimators to
# reason over 415 correlated dimensions with only 712 training rows), also
# expose each low-dimensional feature block as its own independently-scaled
# view. Each view gets a much healthier sample-to-dimension ratio for

VIEW_SLICES = {
    "margin": (0, 64),
    "shape": (64, 128),
    "texture": (128, 192),
    "block_stats": (192, 210),
    "geom": (210, 225),
    "cnn": (225, 275),
}

view_scalers = {}
view_train = {}
view_val = {}
view_test = {}
for view_name, (view_start, view_end) in VIEW_SLICES.items():
    view_scaler = StandardScaler()
    view_train[view_name] = view_scaler.fit_transform(X_train_raw[:, view_start:view_end])
    view_val[view_name] = view_scaler.transform(X_val_raw[:, view_start:view_end])
    view_test[view_name] = view_scaler.transform(X_test_raw[:, view_start:view_end])

feature_scaler = StandardScaler()

X_val = feature_scaler.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test = feature_scaler.transform(X_test_raw)

# Train-only PCA on the scaled features: decorrelated, variance-ranked

X_test = np.concatenate([X_test, pca.transform(X_test)], axis=1)
FEATURE_NAMES = FEATURE_NAMES + [f"pca_{i}" for i in range(pca.n_components_)]

print(
    f"Train features: {X_train.shape}, Val features: {X_val.shape}, Test features: {X_test.shape}"
)
print(
    f"Feature groups -> raw:{len(RAW_FEATURE_COLS)}, block_stats:{stats_train.shape[1]}, geometric:{geom_train.shape[1]}, cnn_pca:{cnn_train.shape[1]}, pca:{pca.n_components_}"
)
print(
    f"Classes represented in train split: {len(np.unique(y_train))}/99, in val split: {len(np.unique(y_val))}/99"
