# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design (ArcFace embedding network)
# ==================================================================

INPUT_DIM = tabular_train_full.shape[1] + geo_train_full.shape[1] + N_PCA_COMPONENTS
NUM_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)
EMBED_DIM = 256
HIDDEN_DIM = 512
DROPOUT = 0.4


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual FC block for a small, low-sample-count tabular embedding net."""

    def __init__(self, dim, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.bn2(self.fc2(out))
        out = out + identity
        return self.act(out)


class LeafEmbeddingNet(nn.Module):
    """Encodes fused tabular+geometric+CNN-PCA features into an L2-normalized embedding."""

    def __init__(
        self, input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(input_dim)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block1 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.block2 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, embed_dim)
        self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_bn(x)
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.embed_bn(x)
        embedding = F.normalize(x, p=2, dim=1)
        return embedding


class ArcMarginProduct(nn.Module):
    """ArcFace additive angular-margin head: widens angular gaps between classes, which matters
    when each of the 99 classes only has ~13 training exemplars to define its region."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_classes, s=30.0, m=0.20):
        super().__init__()
        self.s = s
        self.m = m
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(num_classes, embed_dim))
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight)

    def forward(self, embeddings, labels=None):
        W = F.normalize(self.weight, p=2, dim=1)
        cosine = F.linear(embeddings, W)  # (batch, num_classes), range [-1, 1]
        if labels is None:
            # Inference: no margin injected, plain scaled cosine logits -> softmax probabilities
            return cosine * self.s
        cosine = cosine.clamp(-1 + 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        theta = torch.acos(cosine)
        target_logit = torch.cos(theta + self.m)
        one_hot = torch.zeros_like(cosine)
        one_hot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
        logits = one_hot * target_logit + (1.0 - one_hot) * cosine
        logits = logits * self.s
        return logits


# NN model/arc_head/optimizer/scheduler are (re)instantiated fresh per fold in training_evaluation
# so each fold trains from an independent random init on that fold's own data only.
# GBDT and SVM branches reuse the identical per-fold-scaled fused feature matrix as the NN.
GBDT_PARAMS = dict(
    max_iter=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_leaf_nodes=15,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    l2_regularization=1.0,
    random_state=SEED,
)
SVM_PARAMS = dict(
    kernel="rbf", C=10, gamma="scale", probability=True, random_state=SEED
)

print(
    f"Model design ready -> input_dim={INPUT_DIM}, embed_dim={EMBED_DIM}, "
    f"num_classes={NUM_CLASSES}, device={DEVICE}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

ALL_CLASS_INDICES = list(range(NUM_CLASSES))
BATCH_SIZE = 64
# Light gaussian-noise augmentation on the fused feature vector acts as a regularizer
# against overfitting given the very small per-class sample count (~13 train examples/class).
AUG_NOISE_STD = 0.03
MAX_EPOCHS = 400
PATIENCE = 30

oof_probs_nn = np.zeros((len(y_all), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_probs_gbdt = np.zeros((len(y_all), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
oof_probs_svm = np.zeros((len(y_all), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

test_probs_nn_sum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_gbdt_sum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_svm_sum = np.zeros((len(test_ids), NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5-fold training of the 3 heterogeneous branches (NN / GBDT / SVM)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for fold_i, (fold_train_idx, fold_val_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits):
    print(f"\n===== Fold {fold_i + 1}/{len(fold_splits)} =====")
    y_train_fold = y_all[fold_train_idx]
    y_val_fold = y_all[fold_val_idx]

    # -------- per-fold scaling / PCA (fit on this fold's train rows only) --------
    tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[fold_train_idx])
    tabular_train_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full)
    tabular_test_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)

    geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[fold_train_idx])
    geo_train_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full)
    geo_test_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)

    cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[fold_train_idx])
    cnn_train_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full)
    cnn_test_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full)

    n_pca = min(N_PCA_COMPONENTS, len(fold_train_idx) - 1, cnn_train_scaled.shape[1])
    cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca, random_state=SEED).fit(
        cnn_train_scaled[fold_train_idx]
    )
    cnn_train_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_train_scaled)
    cnn_test_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_test_scaled)

    X_full_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_train_scaled, geo_train_scaled, cnn_train_pca], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_test_scaled, geo_test_scaled, cnn_test_pca], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_train = X_full_fold[fold_train_idx]
    X_val = X_full_fold[fold_val_idx]

    # ======================== Branch 1: ArcFace NN ========================
    model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
        input_dim=X_train.shape[1],
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM,
        hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM,
        dropout=DROPOUT,
    ).to(DEVICE)
    arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
    ).to(DEVICE)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        list(model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
    )

    X_train_t = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float()
    y_train_t = torch.from_numpy(y_train_fold).long()
    X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(DEVICE)
    y_val_np = y_val_fold.astype(np.int64)
    X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(DEVICE)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    best_model_path = os.path.join(
        WORKING_DIR, f"best_arcface_model_fold{fold_i}.pt"
    )
    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        arc_head.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
                xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            embeddings = model(xb)
            logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        # -------------------- Validation (margin-free cosine softmax) --------------------
        model.eval()
        arc_head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
            val_logits = arc_head(
                val_embeddings, labels=None
            )  # plain scaled cosine, no margin
            val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(
                {"model": model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
                best_model_path,
            )
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epoch % 10 == 0 or epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"Fold {fold_i + 1} | Epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | "
                f"val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} | best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} "
                f"| no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Fold {fold_i + 1}: early stopping at epoch {epoch}.")
            break

    checkpoint = torch.load(best_model_path, map_location=DEVICE)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
    model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
        nn_val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        test_embeddings = model(X_test_t)
        test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
        nn_test_probs = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    nn_val_probs = nn_val_probs / nn_val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    nn_test_probs = nn_test_probs / nn_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    oof_probs_nn[fold_val_idx] = nn_val_probs
    test_probs_nn_sum += nn_test_probs

    # ======================== Branch 2: HistGradientBoosting ========================
    gbdt = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**GBDT_PARAMS)
    gbdt.fit(X_train, y_train_fold)
    gbdt_val_probs = gbdt.predict_proba(X_val)
    gbdt_test_probs = gbdt.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    oof_probs_gbdt[fold_val_idx] = gbdt_val_probs
    test_probs_gbdt_sum += gbdt_test_probs

    # ======================== Branch 3: RBF-kernel SVM ========================
    svm = SVC(**SVM_PARAMS)
    svm.fit(X_train, y_train_fold)
    svm_val_probs = svm.predict_proba(X_val)
    svm_test_probs = svm.predict_proba(X_test_fold)
    oof_probs_svm[fold_val_idx] = svm_val_probs
    test_probs_svm_sum += svm_test_probs

    fold_nn_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val_fold, np.clip(nn_val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15), labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
    )
    fold_gbdt_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val_fold,
        np.clip(gbdt_val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    fold_svm_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val_fold, np.clip(svm_val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15), labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
    )
    print(
        f"Fold {fold_i + 1} val logloss -> NN: {fold_nn_logloss:.4f} | "
        f"GBDT: {fold_gbdt_logloss:.4f} | SVM: {fold_svm_logloss:.4f}"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Renormalize OOF/test probabilities from each branch
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_probs_nn = oof_probs_nn / oof_probs_nn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
oof_probs_gbdt = oof_probs_gbdt / oof_probs_gbdt.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
oof_probs_svm = oof_probs_svm / oof_probs_svm.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

test_probs_nn = test_probs_nn_sum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_gbdt = test_probs_gbdt_sum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_svm = test_probs_svm_sum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_nn = test_probs_nn / test_probs_nn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs_gbdt = test_probs_gbdt / test_probs_gbdt.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs_svm = test_probs_svm / test_probs_svm.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

for name, oof_p in (
    ("NN", oof_probs_nn),
    ("GBDT", oof_probs_gbdt),
    ("SVM", oof_probs_svm),
):
    branch_logloss = log_loss(
        y_all, np.clip(oof_p, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15), labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES
    )
    print(f"Overall 5-fold OOF logloss ({name}): {branch_logloss:.4f}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stacking meta-learner over OOF probabilities from the 3 branches
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
meta_features_oof = np.concatenate(
    [oof_probs_nn, oof_probs_gbdt, oof_probs_svm], axis=1
)
meta_features_test = np.concatenate(
    [test_probs_nn, test_probs_gbdt, test_probs_svm], axis=1
)

meta_learner = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, random_state=SEED)

meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
meta_oof_probs = cross_val_predict(
    meta_learner, meta_features_oof, y_all, cv=meta_cv, method="predict_proba"
)
meta_oof_probs = np.clip(meta_oof_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
meta_oof_probs = meta_oof_probs / meta_oof_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

final_val_logloss = log_loss(y_all, meta_oof_probs, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

meta_learner.fit(meta_features_oof, y_all)
test_probs = meta_learner.predict_proba(meta_features_test)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = final_val_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os

train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))

GEO_DIM = 16


def extract_geometric_features(img_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    c = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(c)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(c)
    aspect_ratio = w / float(h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    rect_area = w * h
    extent = area / rect_area if rect_area > 0 else 0.0
    hull = cv2.convexHull(c)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = area / hull_area if hull_area > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter = np.sqrt(4 * area / np.pi) if area > 0 else 0.0
    if len(c) >= 5:
        _, (MA, ma), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(c)
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1 - (min(MA, ma) / max(MA, ma)) ** 2) if max(MA, ma) > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2) / area if area > 0 else 0.0
    circularity = 4 * np.pi * area / (perimeter**2) if perimeter > 0 else 0.0
    moments = cv2.moments(c)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)
    geo = np.array(
        [
            area,
            perimeter,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter,
            eccentricity,
            compactness,
            circularity,
        ],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    return np.concatenate([geo, hu.astype(np.float32)])

IMG_SIZE = 128
IMAGENET_MEAN = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
IMAGENET_STD = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(1, 3, 1, 1)


class LeafImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids):
        self.ids = ids

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if img is None:
            img = np.zeros((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.resize(img, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        tensor = torch.from_numpy(img).float().unsqueeze(0) / 255.0
        tensor = tensor.repeat(3, 1, 1)
        return tensor


try:
    from torchvision.models import ResNet18_Weights

    backbone = tv_models.resnet18(weights=ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
except Exception:
    try:
        backbone = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=True)
    except Exception:
        backbone = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=False)

feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(*list(backbone.children())[:-1]).to(DEVICE).eval()
for p in feature_extractor.parameters():
    p.requires_grad_(False)


def extract_cnn_embeddings(ids):
    dataset = LeafImageDataset(ids)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)
    all_embeds = []
    mean = IMAGENET_MEAN.to(DEVICE)
    std = IMAGENET_STD.to(DEVICE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            batch = batch.to(DEVICE)
            norm_batch = (batch - mean) / std
            flip_batch = torch.flip(norm_batch, dims=[3])
            emb_orig = feature_extractor(norm_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_flip = feature_extractor(flip_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_avg = (emb_orig + emb_flip) / 2.0
            all_embeds.append(emb_avg.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeds, axis=0)

# STEP 2: Model design (ArcFace embedding network)

INPUT_DIM = TOTAL_INPUT_DIM
NUM_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)
EMBED_DIM = 256
HIDDEN_DIM = 512
DROPOUT = 0.4


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual FC block for a small, low-sample-count tabular embedding net."""

    def __init__(self, dim, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.bn2(self.fc2(out))
        out = out + identity
        return self.act(out)


class LeafEmbeddingNet(nn.Module):
    """Encodes fused tabular+geometric+CNN-PCA features into an L2-normalized embedding."""

    def __init__(
        self, input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(input_dim)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block1 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.block2 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, embed_dim)
        self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_bn(x)
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.embed_bn(x)
        embedding = F.normalize(x, p=2, dim=1)
        return embedding


class ArcMarginProduct(nn.Module):
    """ArcFace additive angular-margin head: widens angular gaps between classes, which matters
    when each of the 99 classes only has ~13 training exemplars to define its region."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_classes, s=30.0, m=0.20):
        super().__init__()
        self.s = s
        self.m = m
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(num_classes, embed_dim))
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight)

    def forward(self, embeddings, labels=None):
        W = F.normalize(self.weight, p=2, dim=1)
        cosine = F.linear(embeddings, W)  # (batch, num_classes), range [-1, 1]
        if labels is None:
            # Inference: no margin injected, plain scaled cosine logits -> softmax probabilities
            return cosine * self.s
        cosine = cosine.clamp(-1 + 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        theta = torch.acos(cosine)
        target_logit = torch.cos(theta + self.m)
        one_hot = torch.zeros_like(cosine)
        one_hot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
        logits = one_hot * target_logit + (1.0 - one_hot) * cosine
        logits = logits * self.s
        return logits


def build_fold_model(input_dim, fold_idx=0):
    """Freshly-initialized (model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler) tuple per CV fold."""
    torch.manual_seed(SEED + fold_idx)

    model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
        input_dim=input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)
    arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
    ).to(DEVICE)

    # Cross-entropy over ArcFace-margin logits -> softmax probabilities are log-loss compatible.
    # Light label smoothing guards against overconfident predictions given the sparse per-class data.
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        list(model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )

    # Warm restarts help escape sharp minima given the tiny per-class sample count.
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
    )

    return model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler


print(
    f"Model design ready -> input_dim={INPUT_DIM}, embed_dim={EMBED_DIM}, "
    f"num_classes={NUM_CLASSES}, device={DEVICE}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

BEST_MODEL_PATH_TEMPLATE = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, "best_arcface_model_fold{fold}.pt")

ALL_CLASS_INDICES = list(range(NUM_CLASSES))

BATCH_SIZE = 64

# Light gaussian-noise augmentation on the fused feature vector acts as a regularizer
# against overfitting given the very small per-class sample count (~13 train examples/class).
AUG_NOISE_STD = 0.03

MAX_EPOCHS = 400
PATIENCE = 30

oof_probs = np.zeros((tabular_train_full.shape[0], NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
test_probs_sum = np.zeros((tabular_test_full.shape[0], NUM_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5-fold CV training loop: fresh model per fold, true OOF predictions,
# bagged test predictions across folds
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for fold_idx, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits):
    print(f"\n===== Fold {fold_idx + 1}/{len(fold_splits)} =====")

    fold_tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[tr_idx])
    fold_geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[tr_idx])
    fold_cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[tr_idx])
    fold_cnn_train_scaled = fold_cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full[tr_idx])
    fold_cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca_components, random_state=SEED).fit(
        fold_cnn_train_scaled
    )

    def _fold_transform(idx):
        tab = fold_tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full[idx])
        geo = fold_geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full[idx])
        cnn = fold_cnn_pca.transform(fold_cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full[idx]))
        return np.concatenate([tab, geo, cnn], axis=1).astype(np.float32)

    X_tr = _fold_transform(tr_idx)
    y_tr = y_all[tr_idx]
    X_va = _fold_transform(va_idx)
    y_va = y_all[va_idx]

    fold_test_tab = fold_tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)
    fold_test_geo = fold_geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)
    fold_test_cnn = fold_cnn_pca.transform(fold_cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full))
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate(
        [fold_test_tab, fold_test_geo, fold_test_cnn], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)
    X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(DEVICE)

    model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler = build_fold_model(
        INPUT_DIM, fold_idx=fold_idx
    )

    X_tr_t = torch.from_numpy(X_tr).float()
    y_tr_t = torch.from_numpy(y_tr).long()
    X_va_t = torch.from_numpy(X_va).float().to(DEVICE)
    y_va_np = y_va.astype(np.int64)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_tr_t, y_tr_t)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, drop_last=False
    )

    fold_best_model_path = BEST_MODEL_PATH_TEMPLATE.format(fold=fold_idx)
    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    # -------------------- Training loop with early stopping on true multi-class log-loss --------------------
    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        arc_head.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
                xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            embeddings = model(xb)
            logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        # -------------------- Validation (margin-free cosine softmax) --------------------
        model.eval()
        arc_head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_embeddings = model(X_va_t)
            val_logits = arc_head(
                val_embeddings, labels=None
            )  # plain scaled cosine, no margin
            val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_va_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(
                {"model": model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
                fold_best_model_path,
            )
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        print(
            f"Fold {fold_idx} | Epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} "
            f"| best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} | no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
        )

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"Fold {fold_idx}: early stopping at epoch {epoch} (no improvement for {PATIENCE} epochs)."
            )
            break

    # -------------------- Load this fold's best checkpoint --------------------
    checkpoint = torch.load(fold_best_model_path, map_location=DEVICE)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
    model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()

    # -------------------- OOF predictions for this fold's val_idx --------------------
    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = model(X_va_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
        val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_probs = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    oof_probs[va_idx] = val_probs

    # -------------------- Test inference for this fold (identical inference path) --------------------
    with torch.no_grad():
        test_embeddings = model(X_test_t)
        test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
        fold_test_probs = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    fold_test_probs = fold_test_probs / fold_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    fold_test_probs = np.clip(fold_test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    fold_test_probs = fold_test_probs / fold_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    test_probs_sum += fold_test_probs

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final validation metric: true out-of-fold log-loss over ALL training rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_probs_clipped = np.clip(
    oof_probs / oof_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15
)
final_val_logloss = log_loss(y_all, oof_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference: bagging ensemble average across the 5 fold models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = test_probs_sum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = final_val_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

def add_family_stats(df):
    feats = {}
    family_vals = {}
    for family in ("margin", "shape", "texture"):
        cols = [c for c in TABULAR_COLS if c.startswith(family)]
        vals = df[cols].values
        family_vals[family] = vals
        feats[f"{family}_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
        feats[f"{family}_argmax"] = vals.argmax(axis=1).astype(float)

    margin_vals = family_vals["margin"]
    shape_vals = family_vals["shape"]
    texture_vals = family_vals["texture"]
    n_common = min(margin_vals.shape[1], shape_vals.shape[1])
    row_corr = np.array(
        [
            np.corrcoef(margin_vals[i, :n_common], shape_vals[i, :n_common])[0, 1]
            for i in range(len(df))
        ]
    )
    row_corr = np.nan_to_num(row_corr, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    feats["margin_shape_mean_prod"] = feats["margin_mean"] * feats["shape_mean"]
    feats["margin_shape_std_ratio"] = feats["margin_std"] / (feats["shape_std"] + 1e-6)
    feats["texture_shape_mean_prod"] = feats["texture_mean"] * feats["shape_mean"]
    feats["margin_shape_row_corr"] = row_corr
    return pd.DataFrame(feats, index=df.index)

# 4. Hand-crafted geometric / Hu-moment shape features from raw images

GEO_DIM = 16


def extract_geometric_features(img_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{img_id}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(GEO_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
    c = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(c)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(c)
    aspect_ratio = w / float(h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    rect_area = w * h
    extent = area / rect_area if rect_area > 0 else 0.0
    hull = cv2.convexHull(c)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = area / hull_area if hull_area > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter = np.sqrt(4 * area / np.pi) if area > 0 else 0.0
    if len(c) >= 5:
        _, (MA, ma), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(c)
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1 - (min(MA, ma) / max(MA, ma)) ** 2) if max(MA, ma) > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2) / area if area > 0 else 0.0
    circularity = 4 * np.pi * area / (perimeter**2) if perimeter > 0 else 0.0
    moments = cv2.moments(c)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)
    geo = np.array(
        [
            area,
            perimeter,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter,
            eccentricity,
            compactness,
            circularity,
        ],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    return np.concatenate([geo, hu.astype(np.float32)])

def extract_cnn_embeddings(ids):
    dataset = LeafImageDataset(ids)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)
    all_embeds = []
    mean = IMAGENET_MEAN.to(DEVICE)
    std = IMAGENET_STD.to(DEVICE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            batch = batch.to(DEVICE)
            norm_batch = (batch - mean) / std
            flip_batch = torch.flip(norm_batch, dims=[3])
            emb_orig = feature_extractor(norm_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_flip = feature_extractor(flip_batch).flatten(1)
            emb_avg = (emb_orig + emb_flip) / 2.0
            all_embeds.append(emb_avg.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeds, axis=0)

EMBED_DIM = 256
HIDDEN_DIM = 512
DROPOUT = 0.4


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual FC block for a small, low-sample-count tabular embedding net."""

    def __init__(self, dim, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.bn2(self.fc2(out))
        out = out + identity
        return self.act(out)


class LeafEmbeddingNet(nn.Module):
    """Encodes fused tabular+geometric+CNN-PCA features into an L2-normalized embedding."""

    def __init__(
        self, input_dim, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(input_dim)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block1 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.block2 = ResidualBlock(hidden_dim, dropout=dropout)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, embed_dim)
        self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_bn(x)
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.embed_bn(x)
        embedding = F.normalize(x, p=2, dim=1)
        return embedding


class ArcMarginProduct(nn.Module):
    """ArcFace additive angular-margin head: widens angular gaps between classes, which matters
    when each of the 99 classes only has ~13 training exemplars to define its region."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_classes, s=30.0, m=0.20):
        super().__init__()
        self.s = s
        self.m = m
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(num_classes, embed_dim))
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight)

    def forward(self, embeddings, labels=None):
        W = F.normalize(self.weight, p=2, dim=1)
        cosine = F.linear(embeddings, W)  # (batch, num_classes), range [-1, 1]
        if labels is None:
            # Inference: no margin injected, plain scaled cosine logits -> softmax probabilities
            return cosine * self.s
        cosine = cosine.clamp(-1 + 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        theta = torch.acos(cosine)
        target_logit = torch.cos(theta + self.m)
        one_hot = torch.zeros_like(cosine)
        one_hot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
        logits = one_hot * target_logit + (1.0 - one_hot) * cosine
        logits = logits * self.s
        return logits


def build_nn_components():
    model = LeafEmbeddingNet(
        input_dim=INPUT_DIM, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM, dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)
    arc_head = ArcMarginProduct(
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, s=30.0, m=0.20
    ).to(DEVICE)
    # Cross-entropy over ArcFace-margin logits -> softmax probabilities are log-loss compatible.
    # Light label smoothing guards against overconfident predictions given the sparse per-class data.
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        list(model.parameters()) + list(arc_head.parameters()),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    # Warm restarts help escape sharp minima given the tiny per-class sample count.
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    return model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler


class PrototypeClassifier:
    """Metric-space nearest-centroid classifier: scores embeddings by cosine similarity to
    per-class mean L2-normalized embeddings, scaled by a temperature and softmaxed to a
    probability vector. Cheap to refit on an embeddings+pseudo-labels set without retraining
    the network, which is what makes the transductive pseudo-labeling step below possible."""

    def __init__(self, temperature=16.0, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM):
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.prototypes = np.zeros((num_classes, embed_dim), dtype=np.float64)
        self.classes_ = np.arange(num_classes)

    def fit(self, embeddings, labels):
        embeddings = np.asarray(embeddings, dtype=np.float64)
        labels = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
        norm_embeddings = embeddings / (
            np.linalg.norm(embeddings, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
        )
        prototypes = np.zeros((self.num_classes, self.embed_dim), dtype=np.float64)
        counts = np.zeros(self.num_classes, dtype=np.float64)
        np.add.at(prototypes, labels, norm_embeddings)
        np.add.at(counts, labels, 1.0)
        seen = counts > 0
        prototypes[seen] /= counts[seen, None]
        prototypes[seen] /= (
            np.linalg.norm(prototypes[seen], axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
        )
        self.prototypes = prototypes
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, embeddings):
        embeddings = np.asarray(embeddings, dtype=np.float64)
        norm_embeddings = embeddings / (
            np.linalg.norm(embeddings, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
        )
        logits = self.temperature * (norm_embeddings @ self.prototypes.T)
        logits = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        exp_logits = np.exp(logits)
        probs = exp_logits / exp_logits.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        return probs


def build_prototype_classifier(temperature=16.0):
    return PrototypeClassifier(
        temperature=temperature, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, embed_dim=EMBED_DIM
    )


def build_image_cnn_classifier():
    """Fresh ResNet18, ImageNet weights as init only (not frozen); fine-tuned end-to-end
    on raw silhouette pixels so its error modes are structurally decorrelated from the
    frozen-embedding NN and the prototype classifier derived from that same embedding space."""
    try:
        from torchvision.models import ResNet18_Weights

        cnn_model = tv_models.resnet18(weights=ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
    except Exception:
        try:
            cnn_model = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=True)
        except Exception:
            cnn_model = tv_models.resnet18(pretrained=False)
    cnn_model.fc = nn.Linear(512, NUM_CLASSES)
    for name, param in cnn_model.named_parameters():
        if name.startswith("conv1") or name.startswith("bn1") or name.startswith("layer1"):
            param.requires_grad_(False)
        else:
            param.requires_grad_(True)
    cnn_model = cnn_model.to(DEVICE)
    trainable_params = [p for p in cnn_model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(trainable_params, lr=3e-4, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=40, eta_min=1e-6
    )
    return cnn_model, criterion, optimizer, scheduler

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# K-fold loop: per-fold scaling/PCA, ArcFace NN + transductive prototype branches
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for fold_i, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits, start=1):
    y_train = y_all[tr_idx]
    y_val = y_all[va_idx]

    tabular_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(tabular_train_full[tr_idx])
    tabular_train_scaled_all = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_train_full)
    tabular_test_scaled = tabular_scaler.transform(tabular_test_full)

    geo_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(geo_train_full[tr_idx])
    geo_train_scaled_all = geo_scaler.transform(geo_train_full)
    geo_test_scaled = geo_scaler.transform(geo_test)

    cnn_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(cnn_train_full[tr_idx])
    cnn_train_scaled_all = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_train_full)
    cnn_test_scaled = cnn_scaler.transform(cnn_test_full)

    n_pca_components = min(
        CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS, len(tr_idx) - 1, cnn_train_scaled_all.shape[1]
    )
    cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca_components, random_state=SEED).fit(
        cnn_train_scaled_all[tr_idx]
    )
    cnn_train_pca_all = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_train_scaled_all)
    cnn_test_pca = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_test_scaled)
    if n_pca_components < CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS:
        pad = CNN_PCA_COMPONENTS - n_pca_components
        cnn_train_pca_all = np.pad(cnn_train_pca_all, ((0, 0), (0, pad)))
        cnn_test_pca = np.pad(cnn_test_pca, ((0, 0), (0, pad)))

    X_train_full_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_train_scaled_all, geo_train_scaled_all, cnn_train_pca_all], axis=1
    )
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate(
        [tabular_test_scaled, geo_test_scaled, cnn_test_pca], axis=1
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_train = X_train_full_fold[tr_idx].astype(np.float32)
    X_val = X_train_full_fold[va_idx].astype(np.float32)

    print(
        f"[Fold {fold_i}/{len(fold_splits)}] train: {X_train.shape}, val: {X_val.shape}, "
        f"test: {X_test_fold.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------- ArcFace NN branch --------------------
    model, arc_head, criterion, optimizer, scheduler = build_nn_components()

    X_train_t = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float()
    y_train_t = torch.from_numpy(y_train).long()
    X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(DEVICE)
    y_val_np = y_val.astype(np.int64)
    X_test_t = torch.from_numpy(X_test_fold).float().to(DEVICE)

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=2,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    best_val_logloss = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    # -------------------- Training loop with early stopping on true multi-class log-loss --------------------
    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        arc_head.train()
        running_loss = 0.0
        n_seen = 0
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            if AUG_NOISE_STD > 0:
                xb = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * AUG_NOISE_STD

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            embeddings = model(xb)
            logits = arc_head(embeddings, labels=yb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            n_seen += xb.size(0)
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss = running_loss / max(n_seen, 1)

        # -------------------- Validation (margin-free cosine softmax) --------------------
        model.eval()
        arc_head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
            val_logits = arc_head(
                val_embeddings, labels=None
            )  # plain scaled cosine, no margin
            val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_np, val_probs_clipped, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
            best_val_logloss = val_logloss
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(
                {"model": model.state_dict(), "arc_head": arc_head.state_dict()},
                BEST_MODEL_PATH,
            )
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epoch % 20 == 0 or epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[Fold {fold_i}] Epoch {epoch:03d} | train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | "
                f"val_logloss={val_logloss:.4f} | best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss:.4f} "
                f"| no_improve={epochs_no_improve}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[Fold {fold_i}] Early stopping at epoch {epoch} (no improvement for {PATIENCE} epochs)."
            )
            break

    # -------------------- Load best checkpoint --------------------
    checkpoint = torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=DEVICE)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    arc_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["arc_head"])
    model.eval()
    arc_head.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_embeddings = model(X_val_t)
        val_logits = arc_head(val_embeddings, labels=None)
        val_probs = F.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    oof_probs_nn[va_idx] = val_probs

    with torch.no_grad():
        test_embeddings = model(X_test_t)
        test_logits = arc_head(test_embeddings, labels=None)
        test_probs_nn = F.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
    test_probs_nn = test_probs_nn / test_probs_nn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    test_probs_nn_accum += test_probs_nn

    # -------------------- Transductive prototype branch (pseudo-labeled) --------------------
    # Reuse the already-computed val/test ArcFace embeddings; add train embeddings so the
    # prototype classifier sees the same fold's train rows plus confident pseudo-labeled test rows.
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_embeddings = model(X_train_t.to(DEVICE)).cpu().numpy()
    val_embeddings_np = val_embeddings.cpu().numpy()
    test_embeddings_np = test_embeddings.cpu().numpy()

    confident_mask = test_probs_nn.max(axis=1) > PSEUDO_LABEL_THRESHOLD
    pseudo_y = test_probs_nn[confident_mask].argmax(axis=1).astype(np.int64)
    n_pseudo = int(confident_mask.sum())

    proto_embeddings = np.concatenate(
        [train_embeddings, test_embeddings_np[confident_mask]], axis=0
    )
    proto_labels = np.concatenate([y_train, pseudo_y], axis=0)

    prototype_clf = build_prototype_classifier(temperature=16.0)
    prototype_clf.fit(proto_embeddings, proto_labels)

    oof_probs_proto[va_idx] = prototype_clf.predict_proba(val_embeddings_np)
    test_probs_proto_accum += prototype_clf.predict_proba(test_embeddings_np)

    print(
        f"[Fold {fold_i}] Pseudo-labeled {n_pseudo}/{len(test_ids)} test rows "
        f"(confidence > {PSEUDO_LABEL_THRESHOLD}) admitted into prototype fit"
    )

    fold_nn_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val,
        np.clip(oof_probs_nn[va_idx], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    fold_proto_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val,
        np.clip(oof_probs_proto[va_idx], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    print(
        f"[Fold {fold_i}] NN val_logloss={fold_nn_logloss:.4f} | Prototype val_logloss={fold_proto_logloss:.4f}"
    )

    # -------------------- Image CNN branch (raw pixels, end-to-end fine-tune) --------------------
    train_img_ids = train_ids_all[tr_idx]
    val_img_ids = train_ids_all[va_idx]

    train_img_dataset = LeafRawImageDataset(train_img_ids, labels=y_train, train=True)
    val_img_dataset = LeafRawImageDataset(val_img_ids, labels=y_val, train=False)
    test_img_dataset = LeafRawImageDataset(test_ids, labels=None, train=False)

    train_img_loader = DataLoader(
        train_img_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, drop_last=False
    )
    val_img_loader = DataLoader(val_img_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)
    test_img_loader = DataLoader(test_img_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)

    imgcnn_model, imgcnn_criterion, imgcnn_optimizer, imgcnn_scheduler = (
        build_image_cnn_classifier()
    )

    IMGCNN_MAX_EPOCHS = 60
    IMGCNN_PATIENCE = 10
    best_val_logloss_imgcnn = np.inf
    epochs_no_improve_imgcnn = 0

    for epoch in range(1, IMGCNN_MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        imgcnn_model.train()
        for xb, yb in train_img_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)
            imgcnn_optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = imgcnn_model(xb)
            loss = imgcnn_criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            imgcnn_optimizer.step()
        imgcnn_scheduler.step()

        imgcnn_model.eval()
        val_probs_list = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for xb, yb in val_img_loader:
                xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
                logits = imgcnn_model(xb)
                probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
                val_probs_list.append(probs)
        val_probs_imgcnn_epoch = np.concatenate(val_probs_list, axis=0)
        val_probs_imgcnn_epoch = np.clip(val_probs_imgcnn_epoch, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_logloss_imgcnn = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_imgcnn_epoch, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)

        if val_logloss_imgcnn < best_val_logloss_imgcnn:
            best_val_logloss_imgcnn = val_logloss_imgcnn
            epochs_no_improve_imgcnn = 0
            torch.save({"model": imgcnn_model.state_dict()}, BEST_IMGCNN_MODEL_PATH)
        else:
            epochs_no_improve_imgcnn += 1

        if epoch % 10 == 0 or epochs_no_improve_imgcnn >= IMGCNN_PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"[Fold {fold_i}] ImgCNN Epoch {epoch:03d} | val_logloss={val_logloss_imgcnn:.4f} "
                f"| best_val_logloss={best_val_logloss_imgcnn:.4f} | no_improve={epochs_no_improve_imgcnn}"
            )

        if epochs_no_improve_imgcnn >= IMGCNN_PATIENCE:
            print(f"[Fold {fold_i}] ImgCNN early stopping at epoch {epoch}.")
            break

    imgcnn_checkpoint = torch.load(BEST_IMGCNN_MODEL_PATH, map_location=DEVICE)
    imgcnn_model.load_state_dict(imgcnn_checkpoint["model"])
    imgcnn_model.eval()

    val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for xb, yb in val_img_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            logits = imgcnn_model(xb)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            val_probs_list.append(probs)
    val_probs_imgcnn = np.concatenate(val_probs_list, axis=0)
    val_probs_imgcnn = val_probs_imgcnn / val_probs_imgcnn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    oof_probs_imgcnn[va_idx] = val_probs_imgcnn

    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for xb in test_img_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            logits = imgcnn_model(xb)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            test_probs_list.append(probs)
    test_probs_imgcnn = np.concatenate(test_probs_list, axis=0)
    test_probs_imgcnn = test_probs_imgcnn / test_probs_imgcnn.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    test_probs_imgcnn_accum += test_probs_imgcnn

    fold_imgcnn_logloss = log_loss(
        y_val,
        np.clip(oof_probs_imgcnn[va_idx], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15),
        labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES,
    )
    print(f"[Fold {fold_i}] ImgCNN val_logloss={fold_imgcnn_logloss:.4f}")

test_probs_nn_avg = test_probs_nn_accum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_proto_avg = test_probs_proto_accum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_nn_avg = test_probs_nn_avg / test_probs_nn_avg.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs_proto_avg = test_probs_proto_avg / test_probs_proto_avg.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)
test_probs_imgcnn_avg = test_probs_imgcnn_accum / len(fold_splits)
test_probs_imgcnn_avg = test_probs_imgcnn_avg / test_probs_imgcnn_avg.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grid-search blend weight against true OOF log-loss (official metric, leakage-free)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
best_alpha = None
best_blend_logloss = np.inf
for alpha in np.arange(0, 1.01, 0.05):
    blended_oof = alpha * oof_probs_nn + (1 - alpha) * oof_probs_proto
    blended_oof = blended_oof / blended_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    blended_oof = np.clip(blended_oof, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    blend_logloss = log_loss(y_all, blended_oof, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)
    if blend_logloss < best_blend_logloss:
        best_blend_logloss = blend_logloss
        best_alpha = alpha

print(
    f"Best blend alpha (NN weight): {best_alpha:.2f} | OOF log-loss: {best_blend_logloss:.4f}"
)

combined_oof = best_alpha * oof_probs_nn + (1 - best_alpha) * oof_probs_proto
combined_oof = combined_oof / combined_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
combined_test = best_alpha * test_probs_nn_avg + (1 - best_alpha) * test_probs_proto_avg
combined_test = combined_test / combined_test.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Second-stage grid search: blend the combined NN+prototype prediction with the
# structurally independent, end-to-end fine-tuned image-CNN branch against true OOF log-loss
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
best_beta = None
best_final_logloss = np.inf
for beta in np.arange(0, 1.01, 0.05):
    final_oof = beta * combined_oof + (1 - beta) * oof_probs_imgcnn
    final_oof = final_oof / final_oof.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    final_oof = np.clip(final_oof, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    final_logloss = log_loss(y_all, final_oof, labels=ALL_CLASS_INDICES)
    if final_logloss < best_final_logloss:
        best_final_logloss = final_logloss
        best_beta = beta

print(
    f"Best blend beta (NN+Proto weight vs ImgCNN): {best_beta:.2f} | OOF log-loss: {best_final_logloss:.4f}"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final test predictions using the OOF-optimal blend weights
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_probs = best_beta * combined_test + (1 - best_beta) * test_probs_imgcnn_avg
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=LABEL_COLUMNS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

score = best_final_logloss
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import cv2
from scipy.stats import skew, kurtosis
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegressionCV
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.semi_supervised import LabelSpreading
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torchvision import models as tv_models
from torchvision import transforms
import joblib

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
WORKING_DIR = "./working"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
IMAGES_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "images")
os.makedirs(WORKING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

RANDOM_STATE = 42

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load raw data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Official label order comes from sample_submission.csv columns (authoritative for submission format)
LABEL_COLUMNS = sample_sub_df.columns[1:].tolist()
assert len(LABEL_COLUMNS) == 99
species_to_idx = {species: idx for idx, species in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS)}

FEATURE_PREFIXES = ["margin", "shape", "texture"]
RAW_FEATURE_COLS = [f"{p}{i}" for p in FEATURE_PREFIXES for i in range(1, 65)]
assert all(c in train_df.columns for c in RAW_FEATURE_COLS)
assert all(c in test_df.columns for c in RAW_FEATURE_COLS)

train_ids = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
y_full = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values
assert not np.any(
    pd.isnull(y_full)
), "Unmapped species found — label encoding misaligned with sample_submission."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified split FIRST (before any fitting of scalers/statistics)
#    Each of the 99 species has 9 train samples; an ~80/20 stratified split
#    keeps every class represented in both folds while giving a real hold-out.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train_df)),
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=y_full,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
)
y_train = y_full[train_idx]
y_val = y_full[val_idx]
train_ids_split = train_ids[train_idx]
val_ids_split = train_ids[val_idx]

raw_train = train_df.iloc[train_idx][RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)
raw_val = train_df.iloc[val_idx][RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)
raw_test = test_df[RAW_FEATURE_COLS].values.astype(np.float64)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Feature engineering — block-level statistical summaries of the
#    pre-extracted margin/shape/texture histograms (mean/std/min/max/skew/
#    kurtosis per 64-dim block). These compress each 64-d distribution into
#    shape-of-distribution descriptors that complement the raw bins.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def block_stats(raw_matrix):
    n = raw_matrix.shape[0]
    stats = np.zeros((n, len(FEATURE_PREFIXES) * 6), dtype=np.float64)
    for b, prefix in enumerate(FEATURE_PREFIXES):
        block = raw_matrix[:, b * 64 : (b + 1) * 64]
        stats[:, b * 6 + 0] = block.mean(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 1] = block.std(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 2] = block.min(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 3] = block.max(axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 4] = skew(block, axis=1)
        stats[:, b * 6 + 5] = kurtosis(block, axis=1)
    return np.nan_to_num(stats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


stats_train = block_stats(raw_train)
stats_val = block_stats(raw_val)
stats_test = block_stats(raw_test)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Feature engineering — contour-based geometric descriptors extracted
#    directly from the binary leaf silhouette images (rotation/scale
#    invariant): normalized area/perimeter, aspect ratio, extent, solidity,
#    compactness, eccentricity, and 7 log-scaled Hu moments (15 features).
#    This targets whole-silhouette shape cues distinct from the pre-computed
#    contour-signature histograms already present in the tabular data.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_GEOM_FEATURES = 15


def extract_geometric_features(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    img_area = float(img.shape[0] * img.shape[1])
    img_scale = np.sqrt(img_area) if img_area > 0 else 1.0

    # Leaves are dark silhouettes on a white background -> invert so leaf = foreground
    _, binary = cv2.threshold(img, 127, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    if not contours:
        return np.zeros(N_GEOM_FEATURES, dtype=np.float64)

    contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    area = cv2.contourArea(contour)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(contour)

    aspect_ratio = (w / h) if h > 0 else 0.0
    extent = (area / (w * h)) if (w * h) > 0 else 0.0

    hull = cv2.convexHull(contour)
    hull_area = cv2.contourArea(hull)
    solidity = (area / hull_area) if hull_area > 0 else 0.0

    area_norm = area / img_area if img_area > 0 else 0.0
    perimeter_norm = perimeter / img_scale if img_scale > 0 else 0.0
    equiv_diameter_norm = (np.sqrt(4.0 * area / np.pi) / img_scale) if area > 0 else 0.0
    compactness = (perimeter**2 / area) if area > 0 else 0.0

    if len(contour) >= 5:
        (_, _), (major_axis, minor_axis), _ = cv2.fitEllipse(contour)
        major_axis, minor_axis = max(major_axis, minor_axis), min(
            major_axis, minor_axis
        )
        eccentricity = (
            np.sqrt(1.0 - (minor_axis / major_axis) ** 2) if major_axis > 0 else 0.0
        )
    else:
        eccentricity = 0.0

    moments = cv2.moments(contour)
    hu = cv2.HuMoments(moments).flatten()
    hu_log = -np.sign(hu) * np.log10(np.abs(hu) + 1e-30)

    feats = np.array(
        [
            area_norm,
            perimeter_norm,
            aspect_ratio,
            extent,
            solidity,
            equiv_diameter_norm,
            compactness,
            eccentricity,
        ]
        + hu_log.tolist(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    return np.nan_to_num(feats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


geom_train = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in train_ids_split])
geom_val = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in val_ids_split])
geom_test = np.stack([extract_geometric_features(i) for i in test_ids])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4b. Feature engineering — frozen ImageNet-pretrained CNN (resnet18)
#     embeddings. The 15 whole-silhouette geometric descriptors above miss
#     localized texture/margin micro-patterns that pretrained CNN filters
#     detect; with ~9 samples/class fine-tuning would overfit, so the
#     backbone stays frozen (eval mode, no_grad) and only a train-fit PCA is
#     learned on top of its embeddings.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CNN_EMBED_DIM = 512
N_CNN_PCA = 50

_cnn_device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
_cnn_backbone = tv_models.resnet18(weights=tv_models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
_cnn_backbone.fc = nn.Identity()
_cnn_backbone.eval()
_cnn_backbone.to(_cnn_device)

_cnn_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.ToPILImage(),
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def extract_cnn_embedding_tta(image_id):
    path = os.path.join(IMAGES_DIR, f"{int(image_id)}.jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(CNN_EMBED_DIM, dtype=np.float64)
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_GRAY2RGB)
    rotations = [
        None,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE,
        cv2.ROTATE_180,
        cv2.ROTATE_90_COUNTERCLOCKWISE,
    ]
    views = []
    for rot in rotations:
        rotated = img_rgb if rot is None else cv2.rotate(img_rgb, rot)
        views.append(rotated)
        views.append(cv2.flip(rotated, 1))
    tensors = torch.stack([_cnn_transform(view) for view in views], dim=0).to(_cnn_device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        embeddings = _cnn_backbone(tensors)
    return embeddings.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64).mean(axis=0)


cnn_embed_train = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in train_ids_split])
cnn_embed_val = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in val_ids_split])
cnn_embed_test = np.stack([extract_cnn_embedding_tta(i) for i in test_ids])

cnn_pca = PCA(n_components=N_CNN_PCA, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
cnn_pca.fit(cnn_embed_train)
cnn_train = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_train)
cnn_val = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_val)
cnn_test = cnn_pca.transform(cnn_embed_test)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Assemble full feature matrices and fit scaling ONLY on the training fold
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
X_train_raw = np.concatenate([raw_train, stats_train, geom_train, cnn_train], axis=1)
X_val_raw = np.concatenate([raw_val, stats_val, geom_val, cnn_val], axis=1)
X_test_raw = np.concatenate([raw_test, stats_test, geom_test, cnn_test], axis=1)

FEATURE_NAMES = (
    RAW_FEATURE_COLS
    + [
        f"{p}_{s}"
        for p in FEATURE_PREFIXES
        for s in ["mean", "std", "min", "max", "skew", "kurt"]
    ]
    + [
        "area_norm",
        "perimeter_norm",
        "aspect_ratio",
        "extent",
        "solidity",
        "equiv_diameter_norm",
        "compactness",
        "eccentricity",
    ]
    + [f"hu_log_{i}" for i in range(7)]
    + [f"cnn_pca_{i}" for i in range(N_CNN_PCA)]
)
assert X_train_raw.shape[1] == len(FEATURE_NAMES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5b. Multi-view feature blocks: instead of only the globally-scaled,
# concatenated 415-dim matrix (which forces covariance-based estimators to
# reason over 415 correlated dimensions with only 712 training rows), also
# expose each low-dimensional feature block as its own independently-scaled
# view. Each view gets a much healthier sample-to-dimension ratio for
# per-view covariance estimation (e.g. LDA on 64 dims instead of 415).

def build_graph_pool(X_labeled, y_labeled, *unlabeled_blocks):
    """Stack labeled features with one or more unlabeled feature blocks for
    LabelSpreading/LabelPropagation graph construction. Only features of the
    unlabeled blocks are used (labels are set to -1); returns the stacked
    matrix, the -1-augmented label vector, and index slices so callers can
    recover exactly which stacked rows correspond to each input block."""
    n_labeled = X_labeled.shape[0]
    X_stacked = np.concatenate([X_labeled] + list(unlabeled_blocks), axis=0)
    y_stacked = np.full(X_stacked.shape[0], -1, dtype=np.int64)
    y_stacked[:n_labeled] = y_labeled
    index_slices = []
    start = n_labeled
    for block in unlabeled_blocks:
        end = start + block.shape[0]
        index_slices.append((start, end))
        start = end
    return X_stacked, y_stacked, index_slices

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model architecture: soft-voting ensemble of multinomial LogisticRegressionCV
# and shrinkage-regularized LinearDiscriminantAnalysis. Chosen instead of
# gradient-boosted trees because with only ~7-9 samples/class against 225
# correlated, standardized features, this dataset (Kaggle Leaf Classification)
# is close to linearly/quadratically separable, so a regularized linear
# boundary + covariance-shrinkage LDA estimate class structure far more
# sample-efficiently than tree splits on individual feature thresholds.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_CLASSES = len(LABEL_COLUMNS)  # 99 species


def align_proba(raw_proba, classes_seen, n_classes):
    """Re-index predict_proba's columns (ordered by classes_seen) onto the
    full 0..n_classes-1 species space, zero-filling any species that were
    absent from the training fold so val/test always share one fixed
    column layout matching LABEL_COLUMNS order."""
    aligned = np.zeros((raw_proba.shape[0], n_classes), dtype=np.float64)
    for col_idx, cls in enumerate(classes_seen):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = raw_proba[:, col_idx]
    row_sums = aligned.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    return aligned / row_sums


LABEL_SPREAD_N_NEIGHBORS_GRID = [5, 7, 10, 15]
LABEL_SPREAD_ALPHA = 0.2


class LabelSpreadingChannel:
    """Transductive/semi-supervised channel wrapping sklearn's LabelSpreading
    (kernel='knn') on the scaled 'global' feature view. Unlike the purely
    inductive logreg/LDA/SVC base learners, this channel builds a k-NN
    similarity graph over both labeled train rows and an unlabeled pool
    (fold-holdout/val/test images), diffusing label information through
    manifold structure -- a genuinely different inductive bias than the
    covariance- or margin-based classifiers, which matters when only 9-16
    labeled samples exist per species. Only features (never labels) of the
    unlabeled pool are used, preserving strict leakage isolation. Exposes
    the same .fit()/.predict_proba()/.classes_ contract as the other
    channels so it plugs into the existing log-domain weighted-geometric-
    mean fusion unchanged."""

    def __init__(self, n_neighbors=10, alpha=LABEL_SPREAD_ALPHA):
        self.n_neighbors = n_neighbors
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.model_ = None
        self.classes_ = None

    def fit(self, X_labeled, y_labeled, X_unlabeled_pool):
        X_stacked, y_stacked, _ = build_graph_pool(X_labeled, y_labeled, X_unlabeled_pool)
        self.model_ = LabelSpreading(kernel="knn", n_neighbors=self.n_neighbors, alpha=self.alpha)
        self.model_.fit(X_stacked, y_stacked)
        self.classes_ = self.model_.classes_
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, X_query):
        raw_proba = self.model_.predict_proba(X_query)
        return align_proba(raw_proba, self.classes_, N_CLASSES)


class LinearEnsembleClassifier:
    """Soft-voting ensemble of LogisticRegressionCV + LDA + an RBF-kernel
    SVC, exposing .fit()/.predict_proba()/.classes_ so downstream code
    (written against a single sklearn-style estimator) needs no further
    changes. The three base models' aligned probabilities are combined via
    a fixed, non-negative convex blend (self.blend_weights, summing to 1)
    set via set_blend_weights() after an honest OOF grid search, instead of
    an overparameterized meta-learner stacker. Defaults to equal weights
    until set_blend_weights() is called."""

    def __init__(self, logreg, lda, svc_model):
        self.logreg = logreg
        self.lda = lda
        self.svc = svc_model
        self.classes_ = None
        self.blend_weights = (1.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0)

    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.logreg.fit(X, y)
        self.lda.fit(X, y)
        self.svc.fit(X, y)
        self.classes_ = self.logreg.classes_
        return self

    def set_blend_weights(self, w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc):
        """Store fixed, non-negative convex blend weights (summing to 1)
        chosen via honest OOF log-loss grid search, so the combination of
        the three base models needs only 2 effective degrees of freedom
        instead of an overparameterized meta-learner."""
        self.blend_weights = (w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc)
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        proba_logreg = align_proba(self.logreg.predict_proba(X), self.logreg.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_lda = align_proba(self.lda.predict_proba(X), self.lda.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        proba_svc = align_proba(self.svc.predict_proba(X), self.svc.classes_, N_CLASSES)
        w_logreg, w_lda, w_svc = self.blend_weights
        combined = w_logreg * proba_logreg + w_lda * proba_lda + w_svc * proba_svc
        row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
        return combined / row_sums


class MultiViewProbabilisticEnsemble:
    """Naive-Bayes-style multi-view ensemble mirroring the source dataset
    paper (Mallah, Cope, Orwell), which integrates margin/shape/texture as
    separate probabilistic channels rather than one fused feature vector.
    Holds one shrinkage-regularized LinearDiscriminantAnalysis per
    low-dimensional view (margin/shape/texture/block_stats/geom/cnn) plus
    the existing joint LinearEnsembleClassifier as an additional 'global'
    view. Per-view posteriors are combined via a log-domain weighted
    geometric mean (exp(sum_v w_v * log(clip(p_v))), renormalized per row)
    instead of a linear blend on one fused feature space, since probability
    channels from conditionally-independent feature modalities compose
    multiplicatively, not additively."""

    def __init__(self, global_model, label_spread_n_neighbors=10):
        self.view_models = {
            view_name: LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")
            for view_name in VIEW_SLICES
        }
        self.global_model = global_model
        self.label_spread_model = LabelSpreadingChannel(n_neighbors=label_spread_n_neighbors, alpha=LABEL_SPREAD_ALPHA)
        self.classes_ = None
        all_channels = list(self.view_models.keys()) + ["global", "label_spread"]
        self.view_weights = {ch: 1.0 / len(all_channels) for ch in all_channels}

    def fit(self, view_dict, y):
        for view_name, view_model in self.view_models.items():
            view_model.fit(view_dict[view_name], y)
        self.global_model.fit(view_dict["global"], y)
        self.label_spread_model.fit(view_dict["global"], y, view_dict["label_spread_pool"])
        self.classes_ = self.global_model.classes_
        return self

    def set_view_weights(self, weights_dict):
        """Store fixed, non-negative log-domain fusion weights (normalized
        to sum to 1) chosen via honest OOF log-loss coordinate search over
        the per-view LDA posteriors plus the joint model's 'global' view."""
        self.view_weights = dict(weights_dict)
        return self

    def predict_proba(self, view_dict):
        n_rows = view_dict["global"].shape[0]
        log_combined = np.zeros((n_rows, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
        for view_name, view_model in self.view_models.items():
            w = self.view_weights.get(view_name, 0.0)
            if w > 0.0:
                proba = align_proba(
                    view_model.predict_proba(view_dict[view_name]), view_model.classes_, N_CLASSES
                )
                log_combined += w * np.log(np.clip(proba, 1e-15, 1.0))
        w_global = self.view_weights.get("global", 0.0)
        if w_global > 0.0:
            proba_global = align_proba(
                self.global_model.predict_proba(view_dict["global"]), self.global_model.classes_, N_CLASSES
            )
            log_combined += w_global * np.log(np.clip(proba_global, 1e-15, 1.0))
        w_label_spread = self.view_weights.get("label_spread", 0.0)
        if w_label_spread > 0.0:
            proba_label_spread = self.label_spread_model.predict_proba(view_dict["global"])
            log_combined += w_label_spread * np.log(np.clip(proba_label_spread, 1e-15, 1.0))
        combined = np.exp(log_combined)
        row_sums = combined.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
        return combined / row_sums


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SVC C/gamma tuning: honest OOF log-loss grid search over the same 5-fold
# StratifiedKFold split used below for the logreg/lda/svc OOF arrays. The RBF
# kernel width (gamma) and margin penalty (C) are tuned jointly since some
# classes have only ~6-8 samples per fold and an untuned kernel SVM can
# over- or under-fit the class boundaries.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
kfold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
SVC_C_GRID = [0.1, 1, 10, 100]
SVC_GAMMA_GRID = ["scale", 0.01, 0.001]
best_svc_C = SVC_C_GRID[0]
best_svc_gamma = SVC_GAMMA_GRID[0]
best_svc_loss = np.inf
for C_cand in SVC_C_GRID:
    for gamma_cand in SVC_GAMMA_GRID:
        oof_svc_cand_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
        for fold_train_idx, fold_holdout_idx in kfold.split(X_train, y_train):
            svc_cand = SVC(
                kernel="rbf",
                probability=True,
                decision_function_shape="ovr",
                random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                C=C_cand,
                gamma=gamma_cand,
            )
            svc_cand.fit(X_train[fold_train_idx], y_train[fold_train_idx])
            oof_svc_cand_proba[fold_holdout_idx] = align_proba(
                svc_cand.predict_proba(X_train[fold_holdout_idx]), svc_cand.classes_, N_CLASSES
            )
        svc_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_svc_cand_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
        print(f"SVC C={C_cand}, gamma={gamma_cand}: OOF log_loss={svc_loss:.5f}")
        if svc_loss < best_svc_loss:
            best_svc_loss = svc_loss
            best_svc_C = C_cand
            best_svc_gamma = gamma_cand
print(f"Selected SVC C={best_svc_C}, gamma={best_svc_gamma} (OOF log_loss={best_svc_loss:.5f})")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LabelSpreading n_neighbors tuning: honest OOF log-loss grid search over the
# same 5-fold split used for SVC tuning above. Each candidate fits a

# an unlabeled pool of (fold_holdout + X_val + X_test) global features -- the
# same pool composition used later in the main OOF loop -- so the selected
# n_neighbors reflects the same graph-construction regime it will run under.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_label_spread_n_neighbors = LABEL_SPREAD_N_NEIGHBORS_GRID[0]
best_label_spread_loss = np.inf
for n_neighbors_cand in LABEL_SPREAD_N_NEIGHBORS_GRID:
    oof_label_spread_cand_proba = np.zeros((X_train.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for fold_train_idx, fold_holdout_idx in kfold.split(X_train, y_train):

        )

        label_spread_cand.fit(X_train[fold_train_idx], y_train[fold_train_idx], label_spread_cand_pool)

    label_spread_loss = log_loss(y_train, oof_label_spread_cand_proba, labels=list(range(N_CLASSES)))
    print(f"LabelSpreading n_neighbors={n_neighbors_cand}: OOF log_loss={label_spread_loss:.5f}")
    if label_spread_loss < best_label_spread_loss:

        best_label_spread_n_neighbors = n_neighbors_cand
print(f"Selected LabelSpreading n_neighbors={best_label_spread_n_neighbors} (OOF log_loss={best_label_spread_loss:.5f})")

global_model = LinearEnsembleClassifier(

# Loss function: multinomial (softmax) cross-entropy / log-loss over the 99
# species — this is LightGBM's built-in "multi_logloss" objective used

criterion = log_loss

optimizer_config = {

view_train_full["label_spread_pool"] = X_test
